title: Senior Manager- People Operations
description:
**COMPANY SUMMARY**
  

Irth Solutions is a PE\-backed global SaaS company and the leading platform for damage prevention and asset protection in the energy, utility, telecom, and media industries. With \~350 employees across the US, Canada, and India, we help clients protect critical infrastructure through intelligent software that powers the entire damage prevention lifecycle. We're a scaling company with a builder's mindset — and we're looking for people who thrive in that environment  

  

**JOB SUMMARY**
  

We're hiring Senior Manager\- People Operations to own the operational backbone of our People \& Culture function. This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who has built and run people operations in complex, multi\-jurisdictional environments and knows what "good" looks like in payroll, benefits, and HRIS without needing it to be handed to them. This role is based in our Pune, India office and operates on US business hours to support our North American employee population. You'll lead a team of two direct reports and report directly to the Chief People \& Culture Officer. If you're looking for a role where you can build infrastructure that actually matters and see your impact in real time, this is it.

 **Requirements** **What You'll Own**  

**Payroll**  



* Own end\-to\-end US payroll processing (semi\-monthly) for \~300\+ employees across multiple states, with hands\-on accountability for accuracy, timeliness, and compliance.
* Manage Canadian payroll operations across multiple provinces, including Quebec — navigating jurisdiction\-specific deductions, tax filing, and regulatory requirements
* Partner with Finance on payroll accounting, GL reconciliation, and audit readiness
* Lead remediation and ongoing maintenance of multi\-state payroll tax registrations, including proactive identification and resolution of tax ID gaps in Rippling
* Stay current on federal, state/provincial, and local payroll compliance changes across all operating jurisdictions

**Benefits Administration**

* Own US benefits program design and administration, including medical, dental, vision, FSA/HSA, 401(k), life, and ancillary lines
* Manage open enrollment end\-to\-end — plan selection, carrier coordination, employee communications, and system configuration in Rippling
* Lead broker relationship and serve as the primary point of contact for carriers and TPAs
* Ensure ACA compliance, reporting, and filing (1094/1095\-C)
* Support Canada benefits strategy in partnership with local HR resources (Pune/India ancillary benefits as applicable)

**HRIS — Rippling**

* Serve as the system owner and subject matter expert for Rippling across all modules: payroll, benefits, PTO, headcount, and integrations
* Own data integrity, configuration, workflows, and role\-based access
* Lead HRIS optimization initiatives — building automation, improving self\-service, and reducing manual lift across the People team
* Manage Rippling\-to\-Intacct integration, including issue escalation and resolution with vendor support
* Partner with Finance and IT on system governance, data validation, and new module rollouts

**People Operations \& Compliance**

* Directly manage and develop two People Operations team members — setting priorities, building capability, and creating a high\-performing team culture
* Develop and maintain HR policies across US and Canada jurisdictions, ensuring alignment with applicable employment law
* Support BYOD compliance framework, records retention, and HR audit readiness across US, Canada, and India •
* Manage unemployment claims, leave administration (FMLA, state leaves, parental), and workers' compensation programs
* Comfortable working US business hours from Pune — this is a firm requirement given the payroll and benefits support model for our North American workforce

**What You Bring**


* 7\+ years in People Operations, HR Operations, or a directly equivalent function — with demonstrated ownership of payroll and benefits, not just advisory support
* Prior experience managing direct reports with a track record of developing team members and driving accountability
* Hands\-on payroll processing experience in both the US (multi\-state) and Canada (multi province) — this is a hard requirement
* Deep Rippling expertise; you can configure it, troubleshoot it, and train others on it
* Strong knowledge of US payroll tax compliance, benefits regulations (ACA, ERISA, COBRA), and Canadian payroll and employment standards
* Familiarity with Quebec\-specific requirements (Law 25, CNESST, provincial payroll nuances) is a meaningful plus •
* Experience operating in a PE\-backed, high\-growth, or scaling SaaS environment — you know how to move fast with evolving structure
* Exceptional attention to detail combined with an ability to zoom out and see the system level picture
* Strong cross\-functional communication skills — you can translate payroll and compliance complexity for Finance, Legal, and executive stakeholders
* A builder's mentality: you identify gaps, propose solutions, and execute without waiting for someone to hand you a playbook

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with India\-based payroll or HR coordination (particularly in Pune/Maharashtra)
* Familiarity with SR\&ED tax credits or other Canadian R\&D incentive programs
* CPP (Certified Payroll Professional) or equivalent certification
* Experience with equity/stock plan administration or MIP/bonus program operationalization
* Prior experience managing an RPO or staffing partner relationship

**EDUCATION**


* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance/Accounting, or a related field.

  

**Benefits**  

  

What We Offer* Be part of a dynamic and growing company that is well\-respected in its industry.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.
* Health Insurance coverage.

title: Manager – Marketplace Growth & Client Acquisition
description:
Manager – Marketplace Growth \& Client AcquisitionLegal \& Corporate Services

**Company:** Aegis Corporate Alliance Pvt. Ltd.  
**Office:** Aegis Riverfront, Aluva, Ernakulam, Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Mode:** Hybrid  
**Salary:** Starting from ₹25,000 per month \+ Attractive Performance Incentives  
**Reporting Requirement:** Minimum 3 days of physical reporting at the Aluva office during the last week of every month. Employees may also work from the office additionally whenever preferred or operationally required.

About the Role

Aegis Corporate Alliance Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a commercially driven and highly organised professional to develop and manage our business acquisition through global freelance and professional\-service marketplaces, particularly platforms such as Upwork, Fiverr and Freelancer.

This is **not a routine digital marketing or social\-media role**.

The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying suitable business opportunities, positioning our legal and corporate service offerings, preparing persuasive proposals, communicating with prospective clients, following up on opportunities, improving marketplace profiles and converting qualified leads into sustainable business.

The role is ideal for someone who understands **online B2B client acquisition, professional\-service selling and marketplace growth** and is capable of independently developing a measurable international business pipeline.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and grow the company's presence across selected global freelance and professional\-service marketplaces.
* Identify high\-quality opportunities relevant to legal, corporate, regulatory, compliance and professional business services.
* Search, shortlist and prioritise suitable projects based on scope, commercial value, jurisdiction and internal capability.
* Prepare customised, persuasive and professional proposals instead of generic bidding templates.
* Manage Upwork agency operations, Fiverr service listings/gigs and other approved marketplace profiles.
* Optimise profiles, service descriptions, portfolios, keywords, packages and pricing.
* Conduct preliminary communication with prospective clients and understand their requirements.
* Coordinate discovery calls and transfer qualified opportunities to the appropriate internal professional/team.
* Prepare commercial quotations and scope summaries in coordination with management.
* Follow up systematically with prospects and maintain an organised sales pipeline.
* Develop strategies for improving proposal\-to\-interview and interview\-to\-client conversion rates.
* Monitor marketplace trends, competitors, pricing and client demand.
* Build repeat\-client and retainer opportunities from successfully completed assignments.
* Maintain records of leads, proposals, conversations, conversions, revenue and follow\-ups.
* Coordinate internally to collect suitable portfolios, credentials, case studies and service descriptions.
* Ensure all communications maintain the confidentiality and professional standards expected from legal and corporate service providers.
* Provide structured monthly reports on marketplace performance, leads, conversions, revenue and recommended improvements.

Major Service Areas

The candidate will primarily develop opportunities relating to:

* Commercial contracts and contract review
* Corporate and business advisory services
* Startup and business documentation
* Regulatory and compliance support
* Cross\-border business and regulatory research
* Legal research and professional outsourcing
* Intellectual property and brand\-protection support
* Employment and HR documentation
* Technology, privacy, data and digital\-business documentation
* Due diligence and corporate documentation
* Business setup and associated corporate services
* Other specialised professional services introduced by the company

The candidate is **not expected to independently provide legal opinions or legal advice**. Substantive professional work will be handled by the appropriate qualified team.

Required Skills

We are particularly looking for candidates with:

* Strong practical knowledge of **Upwork, Fiverr, Freelancer or similar global marketplaces**
* Proven ability in online B2B lead generation and client acquisition
* Excellent written and spoken English
* Exceptional proposal and business\-writing skills
* Strong sales communication and follow\-up ability
* Ability to understand professional and technical service requirements quickly
* Client qualification and requirement\-analysis skills
* Negotiation and commercial communication skills
* Knowledge of profile and marketplace optimisation
* Basic understanding of SEO and keyword positioning
* CRM and sales\-pipeline management
* Research and competitor\-analysis capabilities
* Strong attention to detail
* Professional email and online meeting etiquette
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office/Google Workspace and modern productivity tools
* Ability to work independently in a target\-oriented hybrid environment
* High degree of confidentiality, accountability and ownership

Preferred Background

Candidates with previous experience in any of the following will have an advantage:

* Upwork/Fiverr business development
* Professional\-services sales
* Legal Process Outsourcing (LPO)
* Consulting or advisory firms
* Corporate\-service companies
* SaaS or technology\-service agencies
* Accounting, compliance or business\-consulting firms
* International B2B business development

Experience generating business for **legal, corporate, consulting or other knowledge\-based professional services** will be particularly valued.

What We Offer

* **Salary starting from ₹25,000 per month**
* Attractive performance\-linked incentives in addition to fixed salary
* Opportunity to earn significantly more based on successful business generation and performance
* Hybrid working arrangement
* Only 3 mandatory office\-reporting days per month, scheduled during the last week
* Option to work from the Aegis Riverfront office more frequently when preferred
* Exposure to international clients and cross\-border business opportunities
* Opportunity to work across legal, corporate, regulatory, technology and consulting sectors
* Direct interaction with management and professional teams
* Substantial ownership over the marketplace\-growth function
* Performance\-based career advancement
* Opportunity to build and eventually lead a dedicated marketplace/client\-acquisition team as the function grows
* Structured performance recognition and professional\-development opportunities

Who Should Apply?

Apply if you are someone who does not simply “submit bids”, but can understand:

**Which opportunity is worth pursuing → how the service should be positioned → how a proposal should be written → how the prospect should be approached → how the lead should be followed up → and how it can ultimately be converted into a long\-term client.**

We are looking for a person who treats marketplace acquisition as a **business\-development function with measurable revenue responsibility**.

Preliminary Application Questions

**1\. Marketplace Experience**  
Which platforms have you personally worked with—Upwork, Fiverr, Freelancer or others? Briefly explain your role and the results you achieved, including leads, conversions or revenue wherever possible.

**2\. Practical Assessment**  
Suppose you identify an Upwork project requiring the review and redrafting of a commercial agreement for an international business client. Briefly explain how you would evaluate the opportunity and approach the client before submitting a proposal.

**3\. Performance \& Availability**  
Are you comfortable working in a performance\-oriented role involving measurable targets for qualified leads, proposals, conversions and business generated, and can you report physically to our Aegis Riverfront, Aluva office for a minimum of 3 days during the last week of every month?

Work Location

Hybrid – Aegis Riverfront, Aluva, Ernakulam, Kerala

Job Type

Full\-Time

Compensation

**From ₹25,000 per month \+ attractive performance\-linked incentives**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Work from home

* Which freelance platforms have you worked with, and what results have you achieved?
* How would you approach a suitable Upwork project and prepare a proposal for the client?
* Are you comfortable with performance targets and reporting to our Aluva office for 3 days in the last week of each month?
* Do you have a personal laptop that you can use for work when required?

**Company:** Aegis Corporate Alliance Pvt. Ltd.  
**Office:** Aegis Riverfront, Aluva, Ernakulam, Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Mode:** Hybrid  
**Salary:** Starting from ₹20,000 \- ₹35,000 per month \+ Attractive Performance Incentives  
**Reporting Requirement:** Minimum 3 days of physical reporting at the Aluva office during the last week of every month. Employees may also work from the office additionally whenever preferred or operationally required.

About the Role

Aegis Corporate Alliance Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a commercially driven and highly organised professional to develop and manage our business acquisition through global freelance and professional\-service marketplaces, particularly platforms such as Upwork, Fiverr and Freelancer.

This is **not a routine digital marketing or social\-media role**.

The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying suitable business opportunities, positioning our legal and corporate service offerings, preparing persuasive proposals, communicating with prospective clients, following up on opportunities, improving marketplace profiles and converting qualified leads into sustainable business.

The role is ideal for someone who understands **online B2B client acquisition, professional\-service selling and marketplace growth** and is capable of independently developing a measurable international business pipeline.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and grow the company's presence across selected global freelance and professional\-service marketplaces.
* Identify high\-quality opportunities relevant to legal, corporate, regulatory, compliance and professional business services.
* Search, shortlist and prioritise suitable projects based on scope, commercial value, jurisdiction and internal capability.
* Prepare customised, persuasive and professional proposals instead of generic bidding templates.
* Manage Upwork agency operations, Fiverr service listings/gigs and other approved marketplace profiles.
* Optimise profiles, service descriptions, portfolios, keywords, packages and pricing.
* Conduct preliminary communication with prospective clients and understand their requirements.
* Coordinate discovery calls and transfer qualified opportunities to the appropriate internal professional/team.
* Prepare commercial quotations and scope summaries in coordination with management.
* Follow up systematically with prospects and maintain an organised sales pipeline.
* Develop strategies for improving proposal\-to\-interview and interview\-to\-client conversion rates.
* Monitor marketplace trends, competitors, pricing and client demand.
* Build repeat\-client and retainer opportunities from successfully completed assignments.
* Maintain records of leads, proposals, conversations, conversions, revenue and follow\-ups.
* Coordinate internally to collect suitable portfolios, credentials, case studies and service descriptions.
* Ensure all communications maintain the confidentiality and professional standards expected from legal and corporate service providers.
* Provide structured monthly reports on marketplace performance, leads, conversions, revenue and recommended improvements.

Major Service Areas

The candidate will primarily develop opportunities relating to:

* Commercial contracts and contract review
* Corporate and business advisory services
* Startup and business documentation
* Regulatory and compliance support
* Cross\-border business and regulatory research
* Legal research and professional outsourcing
* Intellectual property and brand\-protection support
* Employment and HR documentation
* Technology, privacy, data and digital\-business documentation
* Due diligence and corporate documentation
* Business setup and associated corporate services
* Other specialised professional services introduced by the company

The candidate is **not expected to independently provide legal opinions or legal advice**. Substantive professional work will be handled by the appropriate qualified team.

Required Skills

We are particularly looking for candidates with:

* Strong practical knowledge of **Upwork, Fiverr, Freelancer or similar global marketplaces**
* Proven ability in online B2B lead generation and client acquisition
* Excellent written and spoken English
* Exceptional proposal and business\-writing skills
* Strong sales communication and follow\-up ability
* Ability to understand professional and technical service requirements quickly
* Client qualification and requirement\-analysis skills
* Negotiation and commercial communication skills
* Knowledge of profile and marketplace optimisation
* Basic understanding of SEO and keyword positioning
* CRM and sales\-pipeline management
* Research and competitor\-analysis capabilities
* Strong attention to detail
* Professional email and online meeting etiquette
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office/Google Workspace and modern productivity tools
* Ability to work independently in a target\-oriented hybrid environment
* High degree of confidentiality, accountability and ownership

Preferred Background

Candidates with previous experience in any of the following will have an advantage:

* Upwork/Fiverr business development
* Professional\-services sales
* Legal Process Outsourcing (LPO)
* Consulting or advisory firms
* Corporate\-service companies
* SaaS or technology\-service agencies
* Accounting, compliance or business\-consulting firms
* International B2B business development

Experience generating business for **legal, corporate, consulting or other knowledge\-based professional services** will be particularly valued.

What We Offer

* **Salary starting from ₹25,000 per month**
* Attractive performance\-linked incentives in addition to fixed salary
* Opportunity to earn significantly more based on successful business generation and performance
* Hybrid working arrangement
* Only 3 mandatory office\-reporting days per month, scheduled during the last week
* Option to work from the Aegis Riverfront office more frequently when preferred
* Exposure to international clients and cross\-border business opportunities
* Opportunity to work across legal, corporate, regulatory, technology and consulting sectors
* Direct interaction with management and professional teams
* Substantial ownership over the marketplace\-growth function
* Performance\-based career advancement
* Opportunity to build and eventually lead a dedicated marketplace/client\-acquisition team as the function grows
* Structured performance recognition and professional\-development opportunities

Who Should Apply?

Apply if you are someone who does not simply “submit bids”, but can understand:

**Which opportunity is worth pursuing → how the service should be positioned → how a proposal should be written → how the prospect should be approached → how the lead should be followed up → and how it can ultimately be converted into a long\-term client.**

We are looking for a person who treats marketplace acquisition as a **business\-development function with measurable revenue responsibility**.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Job Title: HR Manager – Talent Acquisition \& Operations**

**Company:** Meadbery  
**Location:** Zirakpur, Punjab (On\-site)  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 5\+ years  
**Salary:** Based on experience (commensurate with market for the Tricity region)

**About Us**  
Meadbery is a fast\-growing D2C Ayurvedic wellness brand selling through our own website and Amazon India. As we scale, we're building our first dedicated in\-house HR function to support our growing telecalling and sales teams.

**Role Overview**  
We're hiring an HR Manager to independently own recruitment and HR operations for our Zirakpur office. This is a hands\-on role — you will personally source, screen, and close candidates, not just coordinate the process. The primary focus is high\-volume hiring for sales and telecalling roles, alongside day\-to\-day HR generalist responsibilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Recruitment (Primary Focus)*

* Own end\-to\-end recruitment for telecalling and sales roles — sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer rollout, and joining
* Deliver high\-volume hiring on tight timelines using Naukri, Apna, Indeed, LinkedIn, and referral networks
* Build and maintain an active candidate pipeline/database specific to the Tricity (Chandigarh–Mohali–Panchkula) market
* Screen specifically for target\-driven role fit — not just communication skills, but resilience, consistency, and ability to sustain outbound call/sales volume
* Track and report real hiring metrics: joins vs. targets, offer\-to\-join ratio, and 90\-day retention

*HR Generalist / Operations*

* Manage onboarding, attendance, and payroll coordination for the Zirakpur team
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation
* Handle grievances, employee relations, and exit formalities
* Support HR policy implementation and basic compliance

**Requirements**

* 5\+ years of HR experience, with demonstrated recruitment for sales, telecalling, or other high\-volume/target\-driven roles (not only corporate or technical hiring)
* Working knowledge of the Tricity job market — salary bands, effective sourcing channels, local candidate behavior
* Comfortable owning recruitment personally, end\-to\-end — this is not a coordination\-only or strategic\-advisory role
* Strong Excel/reporting skills for tracking hiring and HR metrics
* Immediate joiners or short notice period preferred

**What We're Not Looking For**

* Candidates whose recruitment background is exclusively IT/tech, corporate, or international (US/UK) hiring with no domestic sales\-hiring exposure
* Strategic HR leadership profiles looking for an advisory or policy\-design mandate
* Remote or hybrid seekers — this role is fully on\-site in Zirakpur

**Compensation Structure**

* Fixed salary based on genuine, verifiable experience
* Performance\-linked increment reviewed at a defined probation checkpoint, tied to actual hiring delivery (not activity alone)

**To Apply**  
Submit your resume along with specific numbers from your recruitment experience — roles closed per month, offer\-to\-join ratio, and candidate retention. Vague or unverifiable claims will not be shortlisted for interview.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time

Application Question(s):

* Have you personally recruited for sales or telecalling roles (not only corporate/technical/IT roles)?
* Have you recruited specifically in the Tricity region (Chandigarh–Mohali–Panchkula)?
* Do you currently have an active database/network of sales or telecalling candidates in Tricity?
* Have you independently handled end\-to\-end recruitment — sourcing through joining — without handoff to someone else mid\-process?
* Have you personally closed 10\+ hires in a single month?
* Are you comfortable working fully on\-site in Zirakpur, including occasional weekend hiring drives?
* Is your current employment status accurately reflected on your resume (i.e., no undisclosed current role elsewhere)?
* Are you currently employed? If yes, what is your notice period?
* What is the highest number of sales/telecalling joins you personally achieved in ONE month?
* Of that same highest\-volume month, how many candidates actually joined and were still active after 90 days?
* How many candidates have you personally hired (any role) in the last 3 months?
* What was your monthly hiring target in your most recent role, and what was your actual average achievement?
* What is your approximate offer\-to\-join percentage across your last 6 months of hiring?
* What is your approximate 90\-day retention rate for people you've hired?
* What is your current salary (fixed, in\-hand), and what is your expected salary?

title: Assistant Manager – Talent Acquisition & Operations
description:
**Company:** Elite Butlers Hospitality Solutions  

**Location:** RPS 12th Avenue, Faridabad, Delhi NCR  

**Work Mode:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site  

**Experience:** 10\+ years preferred  

**Team:** India \& UAE \| Currently \~15 members, expanding further


### **About the Role**


Elite Butlers Hospitality Solutions is looking for an experienced and highly capable **Assistant Manager – Talent Acquisition \& Operations** to lead and strengthen our recruitment delivery across India and the UAE.


The role will oversee a growing team of recruiters and support functions while personally leading **senior and critical mandates for HNI/UHNI families, private residences, family offices, luxury hospitality and corporate clients**.


We are looking for someone who combines **strong recruitment expertise, team leadership, client management and operational discipline**.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Lead and manage a **15\+ member recruitment/operations team** across India and UAE, with the ability to scale the function to 20–30\+ members.
* Allocate and prioritise mandates based on urgency, business value and recruiter capability.
* Conduct **first/second\-level interviews** and quality checks before senior candidates are presented to clients.
* Personally manage critical and senior\-level mandates.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality profiles and improve closure ratios.
* Conduct daily/weekly reviews covering mandates, pipelines, interviews, offers, joining and revenue.
* Coach recruiters on sourcing, interviewing, candidate presentation, negotiation and client handling.
* Coordinate closely with the **CRM/client servicing team** from requirement initiation through closure.
* Join client calls/meetings where senior intervention is required.
* Understand client requirements and convert them into clear recruitment strategies.
* Monitor proposals, commercials, engagement terms, invoices and payment follow\-ups in coordination with the relevant teams.
* Manage candidate negotiations, counter\-offers, notice periods and joining challenges.
* Ensure proper use of **ATS/CRM/HRMS**, accurate data and recruitment reporting.
* Develop recruitment SOPs, productivity benchmarks and quality standards.
* Support hiring, induction and development of new recruiters as the team expands.
* Oversee recruitment delivery across multiple locations/offices as the company grows.

### **Candidate Profile**


We are ideally looking for someone with:


* **10\+ years of recruitment/Talent Acquisition experience**
* Previous experience managing approximately **10–20 recruiters/team members**
* Strong exposure to **hospitality, HNI/UHNI recruitment, private staffing, executive search or luxury services**
* Experience handling senior and confidential mandates
* Excellent interviewing and candidate\-assessment skills
* Strong client\-facing and commercial understanding
* Experience using ATS/CRM/HRMS platforms
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Strong Excel/reporting and digital skills
* Ability to work in a fast\-moving entrepreneurial environment

The person should be **smart, polished, well\-presented, commercially aware and comfortable interacting with senior candidates, HNI/UHNI clients and business leaders.**


### **What Success Looks Like**


The person should bring **structure, accountability and quality** to the entire TA operation, ensuring recruiters are productive, mandates move within defined timelines, clients receive strong profiles, senior positions receive personal attention, and the recruitment function scales without compromising service standards.


There is significant scope for this position to grow into **Manager / Senior Manager – Talent Acquisition \& Operations**, with responsibility for multiple teams and locations across India, UAE and other international markets.

\- Prepare salary break\-up sheets and obtain Director's approval.

2\. Onboarding and Employee Documentation:

\- Inform IT department of any laptop/desktop requirements for new joiners on their joining day.

\- Prepare and maintain monthly MIS on the number of candidates attending interviews, vacancy status, etc.

\- Advertise vacancies on LinkedIn, Naukri.com, and other platforms to increase employer brand awareness.

\- Review and capture job descriptions from other builders’ websites and job portals to update internal records.

\- Greet new employees, provide a welcome message via WhatsApp group, and guide them through the onboarding process.

\- Prepare and verify new joiner documents, ensuring proper documentation and filing.

\- Issue appointment letters within one week of joining.

\- Perform a thorough review and scanning of new joiner documents and ensure all paperwork is completed.

\- Allot employee numbers in the master sheet and update biometric records on the first day.

\- Prepare and distribute detailed job descriptions to new employees within one week of joining.

\- Conduct HR inductions, introducing new employees to company policies, procedures, and SOPs.

\- Introduce new employees to the office staff, HODs, and Directors.

\- Coordinate with the front desk executive to manage leaves, attendance, and other HR\-related tasks.

3\. Payroll and Benefits Administration:

\- Coordinate with Axis Bank for the opening of new bank accounts for employees.

\- Update bank account details in the employee master sheet.

\- Plan and execute payroll policies, salary structure (breakups), and payment methods.

\- Gather, validate, and calculate employee inputs for payroll processing in coordination with the Accounts Department.

\- Prepare the monthly payroll sheet by the 25th of each month, including updates for new employees, deletions, salary revisions, and bank details.

4\. Employee Relations and Retention:

\- Plan and execute employee retention programs, exit interviews, and full \& final settlements.

\- Issue experience and relieving certificates to employees leaving the organization.

\- Assist in staff seating arrangements and provide administrative support to the HR head.

\- Coordinate with staff and new joiners to address their needs and requirements.

5\. Administrative Support:

\- Supervise housekeeping and maintenance of the corporate office by conducting daily rounds.

\- Assist the front desk executive with inward/outward records, visitor management, stationery, petty cash, and pantry requirements.

\- Coordinate with the IT Department to address technical issues faced by staff.

\- Manage vendor relationships for advertisement services, PF, Naukri, etc.

\- Plan and execute staff birthdays, sports events, and other employee engagement activities on a weekly basis.

Skills and Qualifications:

\- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.

\- At least 2\-3 years of experience in HR roles, specifically within the real estate or hospitality industry.

\- Proven experience in recruitment, onboarding, payroll, and employee relations.

\- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

\- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

\- Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

\- Proficiency in MS Office and HR software/tools.

\- Knowledge of labor laws and HR best practices.

\#About the Role

Vishram Management Group is shifting its global backend operations to its Ahmedabad office and is looking for a strong Multiunit Operations Manager to take complete ownership of the India backend operation.

This person will act as the single point of contact between U.S. leadership and the India team, ensuring that Accounting, HR, Marketing, and Technology functions operate efficiently, meet deadlines, and support the performance of our U.S. businesses.

We're looking for someone with a retail business management background who has managed operations beyond the store level — including accounting oversight, HR, marketing, reporting, systems, and team management.

\#Functions You Will Oversee

\- Marketing Center of Excellence

\- VMG Human Resources

\- Accounting Teams – Vishram Group

\- Technology / IT Manager

\- Backend Business Operations \& Reporting

Business Operations

\- Take complete ownership of VMG's Ahmedabad backend operation

\- Act as the primary point of contact for U.S. management

\- Convert management priorities into clear tasks, deadlines, KPIs, and accountability

\- Conduct daily/weekly operational reviews with department managers

\- Identify problems before they reach senior management and drive them to resolution

\- Build SOPs, workflows, reporting systems, and accountability structures

Accounting \& Financial Oversight

\- Oversee accounting teams supporting the Vishram group of businesses

\- Review AP, AR, bank reconciliations, cash flow, expenses, and management reports

\- Monitor P\&L performance, unusual expenses, overdue receivables, and financial discrepancies

\- Ensure accounting information is accurate and delivered to management on time

\- Work with operations to identify cost savings and improve profitability

HR \& People Management

\- Oversee attendance, productivity, performance management, onboarding, and employee accountability

\- Ensure department managers meet staffing and performance expectations

\- Develop a performance\-driven culture within the India office

Marketing Center of Excellence

\- Oversee the Marketing Manager and marketing team

\- Ensure marketing activities connect to measurable business results

\- Review campaign execution, social media, digital marketing, promotions, and reporting

\- Hold the marketing team accountable for deadlines, KPIs, and quality of execution

Technology \& Systems

\- Manage the Technology Manager and ensure reliable support for U.S. operations

\- Oversee business systems, user access, technology issues, automation, and process improvements

\- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive backend work and improve efficiency

\# What We're Looking For

Candidates should have experience from retail, supermarket, QSR, franchise, hospitality retail, or another multi\-location business, with an understanding of how different departments drive profitability together.

Relevant experience areas include:

\- Multi\-location retail/business operations

\- Team and department management

\- Accounting and P\&L oversight

\- AP/AR and financial reporting

\- HR and recruitment management

\- Marketing oversight

\- Business technology and systems

\- SOP and workflow development

\- KPI and performance management

\- Cost control and profitability improvement

This is not a coordinator or administrative position. We need a hands\-on business operator who can independently manage multiple departments, hold managers accountable, solve problems, and give U.S. leadership one clear point of accountability.

You'll know you're succeeding when:

\- U.S. leadership doesn't need to follow up with multiple India departments

\- Accounting and management reports are accurate and on time

\- HR positions are filled and employee issues are handled promptly

\- Marketing projects are executed on schedule and measured against results

title: Centre Head
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – CENTRE HEAD**

**Location:** Calicut, Kerala  
**Department:** Centre Operations / Management  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Industry:** Aviation \& Education / Training  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director/ Director/GM

**1\. Job Summary**

The Centre Head will be responsible for the **overall management and performance of the Calicut Centre**, including admissions, sales, academic coordination, staff management, administration, student services, revenue generation, and day\-to\-day centre operations.

The role requires a strong combination of **leadership, business development, people management, customer relationship management, and operational skills** to ensure that the centre achieves its admission and revenue targets while maintaining high standards of student service and academic delivery.

**2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Centre Operations**

* Manage the overall day\-to\-day operations of the Calicut Centre.
* Ensure smooth and professional functioning of all departments.
* Implement company policies, procedures, and operational standards.
* Monitor centre discipline, punctuality, attendance, cleanliness, and infrastructure.
* Ensure proper maintenance of centre records, registers, reports, and documentation.
* Coordinate with Head Office and senior management regarding centre\-related matters.

**B. Admissions \& Business Development**

* Take overall responsibility for achieving monthly and annual admission targets.
* Monitor enquiries, leads, follow\-ups, counselling, conversions, and admissions.
* Guide and monitor Counsellors, BDEs, Telecallers, and other admission team members.
* Develop local marketing and promotional activities to generate enquiries.
* Monitor competitor activities and market trends in the Calicut area.
* Build relationships with schools, colleges, companies, agencies, and other potential referral partners.
* Review daily and monthly admission performance and take corrective action where required.

**C. Revenue \& Financial Performance**

* Monitor centre revenue and collection performance.
* Ensure timely fee collection and proper follow\-up of outstanding payments.
* Monitor centre expenses and ensure effective utilisation of resources.
* Prepare and submit revenue, admission, collection, and expense reports to management.
* Work towards achieving the centre's profitability and business objectives.

**D. Staff Management**

* Lead, supervise, and motivate the entire Calicut Centre team.
* Monitor staff performance against assigned KPIs and targets.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews.
* Identify training and development requirements of employees.
* Maintain discipline and professional conduct among staff.
* Coordinate with HR regarding recruitment, attendance, leave, performance issues, and employee\-related matters.
* Ensure proper allocation of duties and responsibilities among team members.

**E. Academic Coordination**

* Coordinate with the Academic Head and faculty regarding class schedules and academic activities.
* Monitor faculty attendance, student attendance, timetable, and academic discipline.
* Ensure students receive proper academic support and guidance.
* Address student and parent concerns in coordination with the Academic Department.
* Monitor student feedback and take appropriate corrective action.

**F. Student \& Parent Relationship Management**

* Maintain strong professional relationships with students and parents.
* Handle escalated student/parent complaints and concerns.
* Ensure timely resolution of service\-related issues.
* Monitor student satisfaction and retention.
* Ensure proper follow\-up of dropouts, transfers, refunds, and other student\-related matters as per company policy.

**G. Reporting \& Performance Monitoring**

* Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly centre performance reports.
* Monitor key performance indicators including:
* Enquiries
* Counselling
* Admissions
* Conversion ratio
* Revenue
* Fee collection
* Dropouts
* Staff performance
* Student strength
* Student satisfaction
* Present centre performance and action plans to senior management.

H. Compliance \& Administration

* Ensure compliance with company policies and management instructions.
* Maintain proper documentation and records.
* Ensure the centre is maintained in a professional, safe, and customer\-friendly condition.
* Coordinate with HR, Accounts, Academic, Marketing, and other departments whenever required.
* Ensure all management instructions are implemented within the centre.

3\. Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in **Business Administration, Management, Aviation, Hospitality, Education, or a related field**.
* MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.

4\. Experience

* **Minimum 8 \+ years of relevant experience**, preferably in:
* Education / Training
* Aviation / Hospitality
* Sales \& Business Development
* Customer Service
* Branch / Centre Management
* Previous experience as **Centre Head, Branch Manager, Sales Manager, Operations Manager, Admissions Manager, or similar leadership position** will be preferred.
* Experience in handling admission targets and a sales\-oriented team will be an advantage.

**5\. Required Skills**

* Strong leadership and team\-management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong sales and business development skills.
* Target\-oriented and result\-driven approach.
* Good negotiation and counselling skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Customer relationship management skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, Excel, Google Workspace, and reporting systems.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and work under targets.

6\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Centre Head will be evaluated based on:

* Monthly and annual admission achievement.
* Revenue and fee collection.
* Lead\-to\-admission conversion.
* Team performance and productivity.
* Student retention and dropout control.
* Customer/student satisfaction.
* Staff discipline and attendance.
* Centre operational efficiency.
* Local marketing and business development activities.
* Timely submission and accuracy of reports.

7\. Personal Attributes

The ideal candidate should be:

* Professional and presentable.
* Highly responsible and accountable.
* Confident in handling teams and customers.
* Proactive and target\-oriented.
* Good at building relationships.
* Capable of handling pressure and resolving operational issues.
* Willing to take ownership of the overall centre performance.

title: HR Business Partner – People & Culture | Hyderabad
description:
**People Are at the Heart of Impact.**

**At Lighthouse Communities Foundation, our work is about creating opportunities for young people.**

**But sustainable impact doesn't happen without the people behind it.**

Great Centre Heads.  
Committed facilitators.  
Passionate outreach teams.  
Strong program leaders.  
People who show up every day because they believe the work matters.

**We're looking for an HR Business Partner who can help these people thrive.**

This is a hands\-on, field\-facing HR role where you'll work closely with leaders and teams across Hyderabad, understand what is happening on the ground, solve people challenges, strengthen HR practices, and help build a culture where employees can do their best work.

If you see HR as more than policies and processes — and believe that **strong people practices create stronger social impact** — this could be your opportunity.

**About Lighthouse Communities Foundation**

**Lighthouse Communities Foundation (LCF)** works in the areas of skilling, employability, and livelihoods for underserved youth.

Our Lighthouse model brings together **Government, Corporates, NGOs, and Communities** through a Public\-Private Partnership to create sustainable pathways towards employment and socio\-economic transformation.

Our centres are built around collaboration — with different stakeholders contributing resources, expertise, networks, and capabilities to help young people access better opportunities.

**Our work is guided by:**

**Empathy \| Inclusion \| Integrity \| Courage**

**Your Role: Be the Bridge Between People \& Purpose**

As an HR Business Partner, you'll partner with regional leadership, Centre Heads, program teams, and employees to make sure our people practices support both **employee experience and organisational outcomes**.

You'll work across:

**Hiring → Onboarding → Development → Performance → Employee Relations → Culture → Organisational Growth**

And because our teams work across centres and communities, this is a **field\-facing HR role**.

You won't just hear about people challenges in meetings.

**You'll go where the teams are. Listen. Understand. Solve. Build.**

**What You Will Do**

**Partner With Leaders \& Teams**

* Act as the primary HR point of contact for employees and managers across the assigned region.
* Partner with Centre Heads and program leaders on people\-related matters.
* Understand team dynamics, people challenges, and organisational needs.
* Provide practical HR guidance to managers and employees.
* Coach leaders on people management and employee\-related issues.
* Ensure HR support is timely, accessible, and solution\-oriented.

**Build Teams That Can Deliver Impact**

**Great programs need great people.**

**You'll support the complete employee journey, including:**

* Recruitment coordination.
* Candidate screening.
* Interview processes.
* Offer and joining coordination.
* Employee onboarding.
* New\-hire orientation.
* Early\-stage employee support.

**You'll work closely with hiring managers and central HR to ensure we bring in people who are not only capable, but also aligned with our values and mission.**

**Help People Grow**

* Partner with central HR teams to implement learning and development initiatives.
* Identify capability\-building needs across teams.
* Support training and development programs.
* Encourage a culture of continuous learning.
* Work with managers to identify development opportunities for their teams.

**Make Performance Management Meaningful**

**Performance management should be more than an annual form.**

**You'll support managers and employees with:**

* Goal setting.
* Performance reviews.
* Development planning.
* Regular feedback.
* Performance conversations.
* Capability\-building interventions.
* Performance improvement processes where required.

**The goal is to create clarity, accountability, and growth — while ensuring performance practices are fair and aligned with organisational expectations.**

**Support Employee Relations**

* Serve as a trusted HR partner for employees and managers.
* Listen to employee concerns and help identify appropriate solutions.
* Support resolution of workplace issues in a fair and timely manner.
* Help managers navigate sensitive people situations.
* Promote a positive, respectful, and inclusive work environment.
* Ensure organisational policies and processes are understood and followed.

**Strengthen HR Practices Across Centres**

**Our teams work across different centres and communities.**

**You'll help ensure consistency while remaining sensitive to local realities.**

**This includes:**

* Implementing HR policies and processes.
* Supporting compliance requirements.
* Ensuring employees understand relevant policies.
* Identifying gaps in HR processes.
* Working with central HR to improve employee experience.
* Ensuring HR practices are aligned with organisational goals, values, and requirements.

**Use Data to Understand People**

**Good HR decisions need more than intuition.**

**You'll:**

* Monitor HR metrics and trends.
* Track hiring, onboarding, retention, performance, and other relevant people indicators.
* Identify patterns and areas requiring attention.
* Generate insights for leadership.
* Recommend practical solutions to improve HR effectiveness.

The question isn't just:

**“What is the number?”**

It's:

**“What is the number telling us about our people?”**

Be Present Where the Work Happens

This role involves **up to 70% travel across centres in the assigned region**.

**You'll spend significant time with teams on the ground, building relationships, understanding local realities, and providing hands\-on HR support.**

**If you're someone who enjoys being close to the action rather than spending every day behind a desk, you'll enjoy this role.**

**Who Are We Looking For?**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in **Human Resources, Business Administration**, or a related field.
* Master's degree is preferred.

Experience

* **3–4 years of HR experience**.
* Experience in areas such as:
* Talent acquisition
* Employee relations
* Performance management
* Learning \& development
* People management
* Organisational development

**Experience in a nonprofit, social\-impact, education, skilling, or field\-based organisation is an advantage.**

**Communication**

* Excellent communication skills in **English and Hindi**.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building abilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with employees across different roles and backgrounds.
* Strong listening, facilitation, and problem\-solving skills.

**You'll Thrive in This Role If...**

**You're someone who:**

* Sees HR as a business and people partner — not just a process owner.
* Is comfortable having difficult conversations with empathy and clarity.
* Can coach a manager through a people problem rather than simply quoting policy.
* Enjoys meeting people where they work.
* Can move comfortably between strategic conversations and operational problem\-solving.
* Is curious about what is happening on the ground.
* Can work with people from very different backgrounds and roles.
* Is comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities.
* Can work independently and take ownership.
* Believes that inclusion is something you **build into everyday decisions**, not just something you write in a policy.
* Is genuinely motivated by the idea that better people practices can lead to better outcomes for young people.

**What Success Looks Like**

**In this role, success isn't simply:**

**“HR processes were completed.”**

It's when:

* The right people are hired at the right time.
* New employees feel welcomed and supported.
* Managers become stronger people leaders.
* Employees know what is expected of them.
* Performance conversations happen with clarity and fairness.
* Teams feel heard and supported.
* People challenges are addressed before they become organisational problems.
* Employees have opportunities to learn and grow.
* HR data helps leaders make better decisions.
* And ultimately, our teams are better equipped to create impact for young people.

**Why Join Lighthouse?**

**Build the People Behind the Impact**

**At Lighthouse, you'll get the opportunity to work at the intersection of:**

**People \+ Purpose \+ Field Operations \+ Organisational Development**

You'll work with diverse teams, engage with leaders across centres, and experience the realities of building people systems in a growing social\-impact organisation.

You'll also be part of an organisation where our values matter:

**Empathy \| Inclusion \| Integrity \| Courage**

Because creating opportunities for young people starts with creating an environment where the people doing the work can **learn, grow, contribute, and thrive.**

Ready to Build the People Behind the Mission?

If you're an HR professional who wants to move beyond transactional HR and become a genuine **people partner**, we'd love to hear from you.

**Role:** HR Business Partner – Field HR \& People Development  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Experience:** 3–4 Years  
**Employment:** Full\-time  
**Travel:** Up to 70%

***Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.***

**Come strengthen the people. Strengthen the teams. Strengthen the impact.**

### **Job Information**

### **Job Description**


ABOUT XENONSTACK  

XenonStack is a Data and AI Foundry for Agentic Systems, enabling enterprises to design, deploy, operate, and scale intelligent agents across digital and physical environments.  

We build enterprise\-grade platforms across the agentic stack:  

Akira AI \- Reasoning and agent orchestration. Turn models into collaborative, policy\-governed agents that learn and act together.  

ElixirData \- Agentic analytics intelligence. Explainable, decision\-centric analytics for measurable business outcomes.  

NexaStack \- Agentic infrastructure automation. Secure, compliant AI deployment across cloud, edge, and on\-prem.  

MetaSecure \- Trust, compliance and defense. Continuous assurance with AI\-BOMs, risk scoring, and agentic security.  

Our mission is to accelerate the world's transition to AI \+ Human Intelligence by making agentic systems reliable, responsible, and enterprise\-ready.  

WHO WE BUILD FOR  

We work directly with enterprise customers who are building AI \- across every industry. Because the platforms are our own, we sit with their CTOs, CDOs and Heads of AI on how AI actually gets built, deployed and scaled inside their business, not as an outside advisor but as the team behind the platform.  

THE OPPORTUNITY  

We are hiring a Talent Acquisition Specialist to own end\-to\-end recruitment across engineering and go\-to\-market roles. You will hire AI engineers, data engineers, platform engineers, and enterprise sales talent \- roles where the candidate pool is small, the bar is high, and the best people are not applying to job boards.  

This is a hands\-on individual contributor role. You will source, screen, schedule, and close. You will not be handed a pipeline.  

ROLE MISSION  

Build a repeatable hiring engine that consistently delivers qualified technical and GTM talent, with short cycle times and offers that stick.  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  

1\. Sourcing and Pipeline Building  

* Build target candidate lists using LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, GitHub, and direct outreach
* Write and refine Boolean searches for technical skill sets
* Run proactive outreach to passive candidates, not just inbound applications
* Maintain a warm pipeline for recurring roles

  

2\. Screening and Evaluation  

* Run structured screening calls against a defined rubric
* Assess technical candidates on fundamentals, project depth, and problem\-solving approach


\- Verify claims on the resume \- tenure, scope, and numbers \- before advancing anyone  

* Write clear, decision\-ready summaries for hiring managers and leadership

  

3\. Process and Coordination  

* Own the candidate journey end to end: first call through joining
* Schedule and coordinate rounds with founders, engineering leads, and business heads


\- Keep every record current in Zoho Recruit \- candidate ID, role, round, date, outcome  

* Drive every stage to an action or a status update within one business day

  

4\. Offers and Closing  

* Run compensation conversations early and honestly, within defined bands
* Manage the offer\-to\-joining window actively to prevent drop\-offs
* Conduct background verification before rounds are scheduled

  

5\. Reporting and Improvement  

* Track time\-to\-hire, source effectiveness, offer acceptance, and drop\-off reasons
* Flag where the funnel is breaking and propose fixes
* Improve job descriptions and screening questions based on what the pipeline actually returns

  

HOW WE WORK WITH AI  

AI is part of the daily workflow here, not an add\-on. In this role you are expected to:  

* Use AI tools for resume screening, candidate research, outreach drafting, and summarising interviews


\- Know where they get it wrong \- every AI\-assisted rejection needs a named human reviewer  

* Build reusable prompts and workflows the team can adopt

  

Come ready to talk about what is in your AI stack and how you verify its output. We will ask.  

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE* Consistent monthly closures across engineering and GTM roles
* A live pipeline for recurring roles, not a fresh start every requisition
* Hiring managers get decision\-ready summaries, not resume forwards
* Offer acceptance above 85%, with drop\-offs understood and reduced

  

HOW WE WORK  

We value deep work, clarity, and execution over activity. You will be expected to clarify, plan, execute, and escalate with options \- not wait to be told. Ownership sits with the individual, and outcomes are measured, not effort.  

OUR VALUES  

Agency \- Be self\-directed and proactive  


Taste \- Sweat the details and build with precision  


Ownership \- Take responsibility for outcomes  


Mastery \- Commit to continuous learning and growth  


Impatience \- Move fast and challenge inertia  


Customer Obsession \- Always put the customer first  

WHY JOIN US  

Hire for the frontier \- Recruit the people building agentic AI platforms, not generic IT roles  


Real ownership \- You own the function, not a slice of it  


AI\-first environment \- Work alongside the products you are helping staff  


Leadership access \- Work directly with the MD and CISO on every senior hire  


Great Place to Work\-Certified \- 14\+ years, based in Mohali  

LOCATION AND WORK MODE  

On\-site \- Mohali, Punjab (Sector 75, STPI)  


Shift: General  


Full\-time, in\-office role.### **Requirements**


MUST\-HAVE* 3\+ years in talent acquisition, with at least 1 year hiring technical roles


\- Demonstrated ability to source independently \- not dependent on vendors or consultants  

* Hands\-on with LinkedIn, Naukri, and at least one ATS
* Ability to screen a technical candidate credibly without being an engineer yourself
* Clear written communication; you can summarise a candidate in five lines
* Real numbers on your own closures, offer acceptance, and time\-to\-hire

  

GOOD\-TO\-HAVE* Hiring for AI/ML, data, or cloud engineering roles
* Experience with Zoho Recruit
* Exposure to product or startup environments where roles change quickly
* Boolean and GitHub sourcing
* MBA in HR or equivalent

Job Description:
As an Energy Manager in SmartJoules, you will monitor and manage the energy efficiency of the facility. You will also implement energy conservation measures and monitor the energy consumption, evaluate business decisions for sustainability, and look for ways to improve energy efficiency. This is a role that will help shape the company's path to achieving our vision of efficiently managing the largest number of Joules in India by 2025\. Specific responsibilities will be reviewed periodically and collectively with top management.


Experience Range:
5 \- 10 years


Educational Qualifications:
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical \& Electrical Engineering
Job Responsibilities:
* Responsible for imaging, piloting and spreading new ways to save energy and serve our clients in pursuit of our Mission and Vision.
* Providing meaningful opportunities for Site Energy Engineers and Site Electricians from various sites to interact with each other to build empathy and support.
* Keeping client engineering teams updated and satisfied, and informed about their own contractual commitments towards Smart Joules.
* Managing site works of vendors and contractors.
* Conduct and/or help the Site Energy Engineer conduct small scale events and trainings on energy efficiency at client site
* Ensuring all information used for billing and monthly reports are accurate and shared in a timely manner with the Central Services team.
* Ensuring Smart Joules' invoices are submitted on time and to the right people.
* Resolving all queries of engineering teams related to billing and keeping continuous track of invoice movement within the client team until date of payment.
* Ensuring Site Energy Engineers stay on top of their billing related responsibilities
* Setting daily energy savings targets based on weekly and monthly targets given by Senior Managers and enabling Site Energy Engineers to achieve the intended results.
* Executing periodic audits at our client sites to ensure our ECMs are performing as intended, and with the intention of discovering additional ECMs
* Providing constant support to Site Energy Engineers to ensure end\-use assets and systems are performing efficiently.
* Take up the activities necessary to ensure achievement of the person\-specific or department specific OKRs.
* Managing execution of maintenance schedules prepared by Sr. Manager in coordination with Site Energy Engineers, contractors, vendors, and clients.
* Handling inventory management at sites efficiently, ensuring the availability of critical spares.
* Ensure the spares/consumables procured for maintenance activities are the best cost without compromising on quality.
* Ensuring vendors are executing all works under AMCs and Warranties in a timely and high\-quality manner.
* Ensuring the data related to maintenance budget estimation is prepared and shared as and when required.
* Ensuring the maintenance is carried out within the allocated budget.
* Share all information related to critical breakdowns and client communication with the sr. management.
* Support the Site Engineers to address all breakdowns.
* Presenting and explaining monthly reports to clients to help them appreciate our work.
* Maintaining all site documentation as per Smart Joules' standards.
* Regularly documenting and sharing best practices and success stories from all sites with other Energy Managers and Site Energy Engineers.
* Using DeJoule consistently and comprehensively to drive savings.
* Coordinating with Projects, BMS and Analytics \& Automation teams to execute onboarding and regular training programs for Site Energy Engineers and clients .
* Ensuring Site Energy Engineers use DeJoule consistently and comprehensively.
* Support in improving the BMS system features through regular use and feedback.
* Contributions to regional planning in line with our goals and plans.
* Coordinating with the HR department for recruitment and induction of high\-quality Site Energy Engineers and Energy Managers for our team.
* Helping with induction programs of other team members in Smart Joules, as needed.
* Mentor and help the SEEs in undergoing training and technical development.
* Ensure the SEEs attend the training sessions organized by Smart Joules.

* Ensure timely availability of medicines and surgical consumables for OPD, OT, and emergency requirements.

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly inventory and consumption reports.
* Maintain purchase records, stock registers, invoices, and inventory software.
* Monitor stock consumption, wastage, and inventory discrepancies.

title: Principal Recruiter
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!


Qualys is seeking an experienced and highly strategic **Principal Recruiter** to join our Global Talent Acquisition team.

  

Reporting directly to the Vice President, Global Talent Acquisition, this is a senior individual contributor role responsible for leading some of the company's most critical and high\-impact hiring initiatives globally.

  

This position is designed for a recruiter with deep expertise in executive search, talent intelligence, market mapping, and complex global hiring. The successful candidate will partner closely with senior leaders and executives to attract exceptional talent across technical and non\-technical functions while helping shape hiring strategies that support the long\-term growth of the business.

  

This is not a high\-volume recruiting role. It is an opportunity to focus on strategic hiring, solve complex talent challenges, and influence business outcomes through exceptional talent acquisition expertise.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

  

* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment for business\-critical, highly specialized, and difficult\-to\-fill positions across Qualys globally.
* Partner directly with executives, senior leaders, and hiring managers to develop and execute effective talent acquisition strategies.
* Drive complex searches across technical and non\-technical functions, including Engineering, Product Management, Cybersecurity, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Operations, and Executive Leadership.
* Develop and execute innovative search strategies for niche, emerging, and highly competitive talent segments where traditional recruiting approaches may be insufficient.
* Build and maintain strategic talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs through proactive sourcing, talent mapping, networking, referrals, market research, and competitive intelligence.
* Conduct organizational mapping, competitor analysis, and talent market research to identify and engage exceptional talent globally.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders on talent availability, hiring strategy, compensation trends, market dynamics, and competitive talent landscapes.
* Influence hiring decisions through data, external market insights, and talent intelligence.
* Partner with stakeholders to define hiring requirements, assessment approaches, and candidate evaluation criteria to ensure high\-quality hiring outcomes.
* Engage, assess, and attract high\-caliber candidates across a broad range of functions, disciplines, and experience levels.
* Own candidate engagement and offer closure, effectively managing competing offers, compensation expectations, relocation considerations, and complex negotiations.
* Deliver an exceptional candidate experience while acting as a brand ambassador for Qualys.
* Leverage recruiting technologies, AI\-enabled tools, and talent intelligence platforms to improve sourcing effectiveness, candidate engagement, and hiring outcomes.
* Champion best practices in strategic recruiting, executive search, talent mapping, candidate assessment, and stakeholder management.
* Partner with recruiters and recruiting leaders globally on critical hiring initiatives and particularly challenging searches.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve hiring effectiveness, quality of hire, recruiting efficiency, and candidate experience.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required Qualifications :**

* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* 12\+ years of recruitment and executive search experience, with a demonstrated track record of hiring senior leadership and business\-critical talent across multiple functions and geographies.
* Significant experience recruiting across both technical and non\-technical functions.
* Proven success hiring for highly specialized, niche, and difficult\-to\-fill roles.
* Strong expertise in executive search, talent mapping, market intelligence, competitive research, and strategic sourcing.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and partner effectively with senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to align talent acquisition strategies to business objectives.
* Exceptional communication, relationship\-building, and negotiation skills.
* Experience supporting hiring across multiple global regions and talent markets.
* Proven ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and successfully lead complex searches from strategy through closure.
* Experience leveraging Applicant Tracking Systems, LinkedIn Recruiter, AI\-powered recruiting tools, and talent intelligence platforms.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within cybersecurity, enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, AI, or other high\-growth technology environments.
* Executive search firm or retained search experience.
* Experience recruiting for leadership, specialist, technical, and go\-to\-market functions on a global scale.
* Strong understanding of global talent markets and competitive hiring landscapes.

We are looking for a **passionate and highly motivated Full Stack JavaScript Developer** who has strong theoretical fundamentals, excellent logical and problem\-solving abilities, and a genuine interest in technology.

* Follow proper coding practices, version control, documentation, and software development processes.
* Work on real\-world AI/software projects and continuously learn new technologies.

Required Technical Knowledge

The candidate should have a **strong theoretical understanding** of programming and software development concepts, including:

* JavaScript fundamentals
* ES6\+ concepts
* Variables, functions, objects, arrays, classes, modules, etc.
* Asynchronous programming
* Promises and async/await

* Error handling

AI\-Assisted Development

The candidate is expected to be comfortable using modern **AI\-assisted development tools** to improve productivity.

However, **AI\-generated code must never be blindly copied or used without understanding it.**

The candidate must be able to:

* Understand every important line of AI\-generated code.
* Explain why a particular approach is being used.
* Identify incorrect or inefficient AI\-generated code.
* Debug AI\-generated code independently.
* Modify and extend AI\-generated solutions.
* Verify AI\-generated answers against actual technical requirements.
* Use AI as a development assistant rather than as a replacement for programming knowledge.

**Strong programming fundamentals are mandatory even when using AI tools.**

Logical \& Problem\-Solving Skills

We expect the candidate to be able to:

* Break complex problems into smaller components.
* Analyze problems systematically.
* Identify the root cause of bugs.

* Understand algorithms and data structures.
* Think about edge cases and failure scenarios.

The ideal candidate should:

* Be curious about how systems work internally.
* Take initiative to explore and experiment.
* Stay updated with modern development practices.
* Be willing to work with new frameworks, tools, and technologies.
* Take ownership of assigned work.
* Be comfortable learning outside their existing skill set.
* Have the mindset of becoming a strong software engineer rather than simply completing assigned tasks.

* **Strong theoretical knowledge**
* **Strong logical and analytical thinking**

* **Ability to understand code deeply**

* **AI\-assisted development skills with proper technical understanding**
* **Passion for technology**
* **Strong willingness to learn**
* **Good communication skills**
* **Professional discipline and accountability**
* **Ability to work independently as well as in a team**

Important Requirement

**We are not looking for candidates who simply generate code using AI tools.**

We are looking for developers who can **think, understand, explain, debug, improve, and build software.**

AI tools may be used to increase productivity, but the candidate must possess sufficient technical knowledge to **understand and take ownership of the final code.**

Candidates may be asked to explain code line\-by\-line and modify or debug code during the technical assessment.

**About us**





 Bain \& Company is a global management consulting that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
 





 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
 








  




**Who you will work with** 






 Pyxis combines alternative data, AI\-driven analytics, and institutional investor\-led insights to reveal where, how and why consumers buy, how they pay, how much they spend, how their needs and demands are changing, and much more. 
 





 By revealing previously opaque fundamental business trends and their drivers, Pyxis enables investors and business decision makers to efficiently allocate capital and address critical problems.
 





 Pyxis has assembled one of the most comprehensive collections of alternative data covering hundreds of millions of people and tens of billions of transactions across the U.S., Canada, Brazil, UK, France and Japan as well as targeted countries across the EU and APAC. This data provides a longitudinal view of consumer and business transactional behaviors—across nearly all verticals over the last six years—and plays an integral role in answering companies’ and investors’ questions about market share, category size, pricing and promotion effectiveness, assortment optimization, ad targeting, loyalty, switching behavior, disruption, and more.
 





 These state\-of\-the art capabilities enable Bain to provide its clients with a valuable new dimension in investment analysis and strategy development, complementing Bain’s proven “outside\-in” approach with the ability to apply complex data sets to assess company fundamentals.

**Your Role: More Than a Facilitator**

**As a Career Development Facilitator, you will be the person who helps young people connect the dots:**

**Who am I? → What am I good at? → What are my options? → What do I want to pursue? → What do I need to get there?**

You will facilitate the Lighthouse Foundation Course, conduct career assessments and counselling, and guide students towards skilling pathways that align with their interests, strengths, and aspirations.

This is a **field\-first role**. **You will regularly travel across Lighthouse Centres within your assigned region and work directly with diverse groups of young people.**

**Facilitate Learning That Matter**s

Career development isn't only about choosing a course.

It is also about helping young people believe they can take the next step.

You will build trust, encourage participation, support self\-awareness, and help students develop the confidence and agency they need to navigate their career journey.

**Work as One Team**

* Support student engagement and centre\-level activities.
* Contribute to other program initiatives as required.
* Share field insights and ideas that can improve the student experience.

* **1–2 years of experience** in facilitation, career counselling, training, youth development, or a related area.

* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building abilities.
* Good listening and counselling skills.
* Empathy and a genuine interest in working with young people.
* Good documentation and organisational skills.
* Proficiency in the **regional language, Hindi, and English**.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across the assigned region.

* Gets energy from working directly with people.
* Believes that every young person deserves access to opportunity.
* Is curious about people's stories, aspirations, and potential.
* Can facilitate a room without making it feel like a classroom.
* Knows when to speak — and when to listen.
* Can turn a career conversation into a moment of clarity.
* Is comfortable working in different communities and environments.
* Doesn't mind being on the road and enjoys field\-based work.

**Your work can change someone's starting point.**
