description:
About 900 students learn ballet with us across seven centres. Every one of them started with a parent asking questions, on a call, on WhatsApp, or at our front desk. You would be the person who answers.

You will help families go from their first question to their first class. Most parents are new to this. They don't know which class suits their child. You find out what they need and help them choose. You will also keep our records in the CRM, look after families on the waitlist with regular updates, and support the team with day to day administration. For some classes, you will also step in as the student coordinator when needed.

**What you'll do**

* Talk to parents on phone, WhatsApp, email, Instagram and in person
* Explain classes, timings and fees
* Book trials and complete enrolments
* Follow up with families and note everything in the CRM
* Keep waitlisted families updated with regular messages, and offer them a place when a seat opens
* Support the team with administration: records, schedules, notices and parent queries
* Act as student coordinator for some classes, as and when required. You look after the students in class and are the contact for parents and teachers
* Tell us what parents keep asking, so we can fix the cause

**What we're looking for**

* Someone who is easy and pleasant to talk to
* Experience in customer service, hospitality, admissions or front office. Freshers with a great first impression can apply too
* Experience with a CRM (Freshdesk, Zoho, HubSpot or similar) is a plus for experienced candidates. We will train freshers
* Someone who keeps track of many follow ups
* Comfortable with Google Sheets
* Good spoken and written English. Kannada or Hindi is a plus
* Comfortable with children and parents
* Based in Bangalore and able to join soon

You don't need to know ballet.

**What you get**

* Health insurance
* Paid leave and holidays
* Free yoga and BarreFIT classes
* Mobile and travel reimbursement
* A flat team where everyone works closely together and ideas are heard

**Common questions**

**What are the hours?**  
Mostly weekdays at headquarters. Since the role includes admissions, administration and coordinating some classes, some weekend and evening work comes with it. We agree on your schedule and a weekday off when you join.

**Will I travel to other centres every day?**  
No. You will mostly be at headquarters. When a class needs a coordinator, you will go to that centre, and we reimburse your travel.

**Can I work from home?**  
Mostly not, because we work best together. We allow an occasional work from home day when you need quiet time.

**I'm a fresher. Can I apply?**  
Yes. We first look at how well you talk and listen. Your first job is welcome here.

**How to apply**

Apply on Indeed and answer the two questions below. You can also send a 60 second voice note to 9731180164\. Just tell us who you are, what you have studied or worked on so far, and why you would like to join us. Freshers, please don't worry about work experience. Your studies, projects or anything you are proud of is enough. We will call selected candidates within 24 hours.

Pay: ₹26,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* A parent tells you, "My daughter is quite shy. Will she enjoy ballet?" What would you say to her? Two or three sentences, in your own words.
* Have you used any CRM or tracking tools, like Freshdesk, Zoho or Google Sheets? If not, just write "none". We will teach you.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**

  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**

  


The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

**Job Purpose:**

  


To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**

  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

**Qualifications \& Experience:**

  

**Education**:

* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**

  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance

**Key Performance Indicators:**

  

**KRAs**

 **KPIs**

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency

  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**

  


When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths**across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full Stack Engineer (with Infrastructure)
 



  





 About Chattrly
 



 Chattrly is a healthtech startup building the health intelligence ecosystem for patients and
 



 clinicians. Two interconnected products, one thesis: Patient data in India is scattered across
 



 thousands of labs, hospitals, and apps that don\&\#39;t talk to each other. We're closing that gap on both
 



 sides — giving patients a unified view of their own health, and giving clinicians the intelligence layer
 



 that turns fragmented data into instant, contextual insight. Every response we generate has to be
 



 grounded, verifiable, and clinically safe — there is no room for hallucination when a doctor is making
 



 a decision.
 



 What You'll Actually Work On
 



 You'll move across the full stack and occasionally into infrastructure. Concretely:
 



  





 Backend
 



  Build and extend API endpoints that power the clinical Q\&A experience and the patient app
 



  Work inside our AI orchestration pipeline — the layers that turn a clinician's free\-text
 



 question into a grounded, structured, trustworthy answer
 



  Design and evolve database schemas, write migrations against live tables, and ship them
 



 safely to production
 



  Use caching and async task queues for background work like document processing, OCR, and
 



 summarisation
 



  





 AI / LLM Pipeline
 



  Integrate, tune, and evaluate calls to large language models — routing, structured output,
 



 narrative generation, and verification
 



  Work on our hallucination defence layer: deterministic grounding checks plus model\-based
 



 gates that catch hallucinations before they reach the clinician
 



  Help with prompt engineering — we treat prompts as code: versioned, evaluated, and
 



 deployed deliberately, not edited live
 



  Build evaluation harnesses so we can measure regression every time we change a prompt or
 



 swap a model
 



  





 Mobile \& Web
 



  Ship user\-facing features across our patient mobile app (iOS \+ Android) and our clinical web
 



 platform — onboarding, document uploads, the chat surface, and more
 



  Work with native device capabilities like the camera, document scanning, and secure on\-
 



 device storage
 



  Debug platform\-specific issues across iOS, Android, and the web — cold\-boot lifecycle,
 



 modal behaviour, keystore quirks, and the long tail of cross\-platform weirdness
 



  





 Infrastructure (occasionally)
 



  Help maintain our cloud deployments and the services that back them
 



  Write and review container builds, debug runtime issues, tune concurrency and timeouts
 



 under real load
 



  Touch our deploy scripts (idempotent, atomic\-swap, auto\-rollback on smoke\-test failure)
 



 across staging and production
 



  Work with secrets management, server\-level configuration, and database operations against
 



 live environments
 



  





 Observability \& Quality
 



  Instrument features with structured logging — every model call, every critical path, with
 



 cost, latency, and error telemetry feeding our dashboards
 



  Write unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests; our pipeline has an e2e harness that exercises
 



 real clinical scenarios
 



  Participate in code reviews. Every PR goes through a structured review covering correctness,
 



 clinical safety, security, scalability, and data completeness before merge
 



  





 You're a Good Fit If You
 



  B.Tech in CS and have 2\-3 yrs of experience
 



  Are comfortable writing both a backend language and a frontend language — not just one.
 



 You'll genuinely move between them in the same week
 



  Have deployed something — even a side project — to a cloud provider. Anything real, end\-
 



 to\-end
 



  Can read a container build file and an orchestration config without panicking
 



  Understand REST APIs, relational databases, caching, and the basics of async / background
 



 jobs
 



  Are curious about how LLMs actually work in production — context windows, structured
 



 output, grounding, the latency\-vs\-quality tradeoffs. You don't need to be an ML engineer,
 



 but you should want to understand the pipeline
 



  Can drop into a large unfamiliar codebase, read tests, search aggressively, and find your way
 



 around without being hand\-held
 



  Care about correctness. In our domain, "it kinda work" is a bug
 



  Remote\-first, async\-first. We respect your hours and how you work. Output over seat time

title: Store Manager
description:
**Job Title: Marine Store Manager**

**Job Summary**  
We are looking for a responsible and organized **Marine Store Manager** to manage day\-to\-day inventory and store operations at our marine and industrial supplies facility. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate inventory records, coordinating material movement, handling documentation, and assisting customers with identifying and selecting required products.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage **Inventory In and Inventory Out** of marine and industrial materials.
* Maintain accurate stock records in the **ERP system** and ensure all material movements are updated promptly.
* Prepare and manage **invoices, delivery challans, material issue notes, and other store\-related documents**.
* Coordinate with the sales and accounts teams regarding billing, dispatches, and material availability.
* Receive incoming material, verify quantities against purchase orders/challans, and update inventory.
* Issue materials against customer orders, sales orders, or internal requirements.
* Assist customers visiting the store in **identifying and locating the products they require** and provide basic product information.
* Maintain proper arrangement, identification, and labeling of stock for easy retrieval.
* Occasionally assist with **packing, unpacking, loading, and unloading** of materials.
* Check materials for visible damage or quantity discrepancies during receiving and dispatch.
* Coordinate with transporters and delivery personnel for dispatches and deliveries.
* Maintain proper documentation and filing of store and dispatch records.
* Conduct periodic physical stock checks and reconcile discrepancies with ERP records.
* Ensure the store remains clean, organized, and properly maintained.

**Required Skills**

* Good knowledge of **inventory management and warehouse/store operations**.
* Comfortable working with **ERP software, Excel, and basic computer applications**.
* Good understanding of invoices, delivery challans, purchase orders, and stock documentation.
* Good communication skills and ability to interact professionally with customers and suppliers.
* Ability to identify and understand different **marine, industrial, hardware, safety, and engineering products** is preferred.
* Good attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
* Physically comfortable with occasional packing, unpacking, and handling of materials.
* Ability to work independently and take responsibility for day\-to\-day store operations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 12th pass / Diploma / Graduate.
* Previous experience in **marine stores, industrial stores, hardware, engineering supplies, warehouse, or inventory management** will be preferred.
* Experience with any ERP/inventory management software will be an advantage.

**Employee Benefits**

* **On\-premises accommodation facility provided**, allowing the selected candidate to live and stay at the store premises.
* Convenient for candidates who prefer accommodation close to their workplace.

**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Location:** Jamnagar, Gujarat  
**Experience:** 1–3 years preferred; freshers with good computer and communication skills may also be considered.

**Key qualities we are looking for:**  
Accuracy **Responsibility**  Product Knowledge **ERP Skills**  Customer Handling **Inventory Management**  Store Discipline

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

description:
**Position Title: Fiber Optic Splicer**

**Department:** Technical / Field Operations

**Reports To:** Field Supervisor / Project Manager

**Location:** As Assigned

1\. Job Summary

The Fiber Optic Splicer is responsible for installation, splicing, testing, maintenance, and repair of fiber optic cables to ensure uninterrupted broadband, IPTV, and leased line services. The role requires technical expertise, accuracy, safety compliance, and timely execution of assigned projects.

2\. Roles and ResponsibilitiesA. Fiber Splicing \& Termination

· Perform fusion and mechanical splicing of fiber optic cables.

· Prepare, strip, clean, and cleave fiber cables before splicing.

· Terminate fiber cables in ODF, patch panels, and distribution boxes.

· Ensure splice loss remains within acceptable standards.

B. Installation \& Deployment

· Install underground, aerial, and indoor fiber optic cables.

· Assist in cable laying, routing, and ducting activities.

· Install joint enclosures, splitter boxes, and fiber distribution units.

C. Testing \& Troubleshooting

· Conduct testing using OTDR, power meter, and light source.

· Identify and rectify fiber faults, breaks, and signal losses.

· Perform preventive maintenance and emergency restoration work.

· Maintain proper documentation of test results.

D. Maintenance \& Repair

· Respond promptly to service complaints and fiber cut issues.

· Repair damaged fiber cables and restore connectivity.

· Coordinate with technical teams during network outages.

E. Documentation \& Reporting

· Maintain daily work reports and job completion reports.

· Record splice loss readings and maintain fiber route details.

· Update inventory usage of fiber cables and materials.

F. Safety \& Compliance

· Follow company safety policies and use proper PPE.

· Ensure work is completed as per industry standards and company guidelines.

· Maintain tools and equipment in proper working condition.

3\. Required Skills \& Competencies

· Knowledge of fiber optic splicing and testing equipment.

· Ability to read fiber network diagrams and route maps.

· Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.

· Basic knowledge of broadband and IPTV network infrastructure.

· Good communication and teamwork skills.

· Willingness to work in field conditions and extended hours if required.

4\. Educational Qualification

· ITI / Diploma in Electronics, Telecommunications, or relevant field.

· Certification in Fiber Optic Technology (Preferred).

5\. Experience

· 1–3 years of experience in fiber optic splicing (Preferred).

· Freshers with technical training may also apply.

6\. Key Performance Indicators (KPI)

· Quality of splicing (minimum loss levels).

· Timely completion of assigned tasks.

· Quick fault resolution and restoration.

· Compliance with safety and reporting standards.

You’ll work closely with product, engineering, design, and operations teams to turn ideas, requirements, and decisions into clear plans and actionable tasks. You’ll own coordination across multiple workstreams, ensuring dependencies, deadlines, blockers, and decisions are actively managed. The role combines Agile delivery, technical project coordination, documentation, and operational follow\-through. You’ll work in an international environment alongside internal teams, vendors, and contractors. This is an opportunity to have a direct impact on how a technology product moves from planning through release.

* Organize sprint work, including planning, task breakdown, prioritization, and progress tracking.
* Translate product requirements and decisions into clear, actionable tasks for engineering and design teams.
* Track deadlines, dependencies, blockers, risks, and agreements across project participants.
* Maintain accurate backlogs, roadmaps, project documentation, and task statuses.
* Document product and technical decisions, requirements, meeting outcomes, and agreed next steps.
* Coordinate delivery across product, engineering, design, and operations.
* Run regular team syncs and follow up to ensure decisions are translated into execution.
* Support changes in requirements by assessing their potential impact on scope, timelines, and delivery.
* Coordinate operational matters involving vendors, contractors, legal, finance, and other external stakeholders.
* Proactively identify delivery risks and escalate issues that could affect timelines, quality, or product outcomes.

* Experience working directly within a product or engineering organization, rather than exclusively in an agency or administrative environment.
* Hands\-on experience running Agile/Scrum processes and managing sprint execution.
* Experience taking ownership of projects or products from initial scoping through release.
* Strong ability to write requirements, user scenarios, acceptance criteria, and development or design tasks.
* Experience managing multiple parallel workstreams, dependencies, and external stakeholders.
* Experience working with vendors, contractors, or operational teams.
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through testing and release.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**About Chargebee** 




 Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.
 



 Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2\.
 



 With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.
 



  





**About the Team** 




 Our engineering team is a collaborative group of problem\-solvers dedicated to building robust, scalable subscription management solutions. We prioritize technical excellence, inclusive peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning to support our global customer base. You will join a diverse environment where every team member's contribution is valued and innovation is driven by collective expertise.
 



  





**About the role** 




 As a Software Engineer at Chargebee, you will be responsible for developing high\-quality backend services that power our core platform. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to design, build, and maintain scalable features that handle complex financial transactions. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of end\-to\-end feature development while ensuring the highest standards of security and performance.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Design and implement scalable backend services using Core Java and Spring Boot frameworks.
* Develop and maintain high\-performance REST APIs to support seamless integrations with global platforms.
* Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to established engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with stakeholders across product and design teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Optimize application performance and troubleshoot complex technical issues within a microservices architecture.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to the continuous improvement of our engineering standards.
* Ensure the security and reliability of data processing for billing and payment systems.
* Integrate AI\-driven tools to automate code quality checks and enhance development workflows.



  





**What you'll bring** 



* 1\+ years of professional experience in software development and engineering.
* Proficiency in Core Java and building microservices using modern frameworks.
* Strong foundational knowledge in data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design patterns.
* Practical experience with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.
* Experience working with cloud\-based infrastructure and distributed systems.
* Demonstrated ability to write automated unit and integration tests to ensure software quality.
* Expertise in using AI\-powered coding assistants to improve development velocity and code accuracy.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Experience with billing, payments, or financial technology systems.
* Knowledge of containerization tools such as Docker or Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with building or fine\-tuning Large Language Model (LLM) integrations for internal productivity tools.
* Previous experience in a high\-growth B2B SaaS environment.



  





**Benefits we offer** 




*All geographies* 




 At Chargebee, we believe that feeling supported is the foundation for doing great work. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your personal, financial, and professional growth and ensure you thrive in every aspect of your life. Our commitment to supporting our employees is universal, while our benefits are thoughtfully designed to meet the unique needs of each region. We offer comprehensive packages that generally include:\- Health \& Wellness: Robust coverage and access to programs to support your physical and mental well\-being.\- Financial Security: Initiatives to help you build long\-term financial stability.\- Work\-Life Balance: Flexible options and resources to help you thrive both professionally and personally.
 



*Chargebee is an equal opportunity employer. title: Engineering Manager
description:
### **Description**

  

Based in Gurugram, you will lead our newly established software team (currently four engineers) as we enter an exciting new phase of expansion. We are seeking an Engineering Manager who will build a strong, happy, high\-performing team, creating the environment, clarity, and support that enables people to do their best work. This is a people\-first role: you will have proven strength in leadership, scaling teams, and developing others. You will report to the Head of Software Product Engineering.  

Aurora’s mission is to help drive the energy transition through data\-driven energy market intelligence and software that supports decision\-makers across the power system. You will partner closely with colleagues in Oxford and across the business to help the team build customer\-facing software that delivers on this mission.
  

Our platform includes microservices and modern web applications (TypeScript/Node, React, AWS). While this is a leadership\-focused role, you will still do some hands\-on senior engineering work, contributing code when needed, leading by example on quality, and helping the team make sound technical decisions
  

You will establish the people and process foundations for an effective engineering team: regular 1:1s, coaching and feedback, inclusive ways of working, and strong delivery practices (planning, stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives). A key part of the role is growing the team through hiring, attracting, assessing, and onboarding great talent in Gurugram.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead and grow the Gurugram engineering team, creating a positive, inclusive, high\-trust culture with strong team health and engagement.
* Hire, onboard, and retain great engineers, owning the hiring process end\-to\-end in partnership with HR and engineering leadership.
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members through 1:1s, goal setting, feedback, and growth plans; support performance management when needed.
* Contribute as a senior engineer: write and review code, guide architecture and technical design, and continuously raise the bar on engineering standards (testing, reliability, and maintainability).
* Run effective engineering processes and ceremonies (planning, daily coordination, reviews, and especially high\-quality retrospectives) that drive continuous improvement and predictable delivery.
* Partner with Product and stakeholders to shape priorities, manage expectations, and ensure the team delivers valuable outcomes with a sustainable pace and high quality

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 **Required attributes:*** Strong people leadership and emotional intelligence: able to build trust, communicate clearly, handle difficult conversations, and foster psychological safety.
* Proven experience coaching, mentoring, and developing engineers (including regular 1:1s, feedback, goal setting, and progression support), with a genuine interest in people development.
* Demonstrated hiring capability: defining roles, running structured interviews, assessing both technical and behavioural skills, and making high\-quality hiring decisions.
* Experience running effective team processes (e.g., planning, reviews, and retrospectives) and using outcomes to drive continuous improvement.
* Able to lead within a distributed environment and collaborate effectively with Oxford\-based colleagues through proactive communication and inclusion.
* Experience working hands\-on with our (or similar) stack: Node/TypeScript, ExpressJS, React, SQL/NoSQL, AWS and microservices.
* Strong organisational skills: can balance competing priorities, create clarity, and follow through on commitments.

**Desirable attributes:*** Experience using delivery metrics (e.g., DORA) to inform team practices.
* Experience with engineering quality practices such as unit testing and CI/CD pipelines.

  

### **What we offer**

  

Some of the benefits we include are:* Accidental, term life and medical insurance
* Hybrid Work model
* Employee’s Provident Fund Scheme
* Maternity leave
* A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
* Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects

The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavorable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.

To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period.  

  

Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications via email, telephone, or social media platforms. To be considered for this position, please submit your application using the link provided. Our platform runs inside banks and financial institutions, and this role owns a module of it end to end — design, build, test, deploy and the support that follows.

It is a senior individual\-contributor seat. You review junior work, you make the design calls for your area, and you are the person the team asks when something in your module behaves oddly in production.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own a module end to end. Design, build, test, deploy and support it. No handing off the hard half.
* Build async services. FastAPI and modern Python, against PostgreSQL at production volume.
* Integrate with banks. REST, webhooks and file interfaces against client systems, sandboxes and change windows.
* Review junior work. Code review that teaches rather than just blocks. Several juniors and freshers sit beneath this layer.
* Write tests as standard. Not a separate phase, not a later ticket.
* Tune what you built. Query performance, connection handling and cost — you own the numbers for your module.

**What You Bring:**

* 3–5 years in backend Python.
* FastAPI or an equivalent async framework in production, not in a tutorial.
* PostgreSQL — schema design, query tuning and migrations you have run against live data.
* REST API design, and integration work against third\-party or financial APIs.
* B.E. / B. Tech / MCA or equivalent.

**What Would Be Great to Have:**

* SQLAlchemy 2\.0 async; Celery and Redis.
* Docker and a working understanding of how your code gets deployed.
* On\-premise deployment at a client site.
* Lending, payments, collections or onboarding domain exposure.
* Backend: Python 3\.11\+, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2\.0 async, Pydantic v2, Celery
* Data: PostgreSQL, Redis
* Integration: REST, webhooks, file interfaces, bank connectivity
* Delivery: Docker, CI/CD, pytest
* AI\-assisted development: Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor

Job Purpose

The Steward/Waiter is responsible for providing exceptional dining service to guests by ensuring a warm welcome, accurate order taking, timely food and beverage service, and maintaining the highest standards of hospitality, cleanliness, and professionalism. The role is essential in creating a memorable European dining experience that reflects the values and service standards of Olegio Gastronomy Pvt. Ltd.

\* Serve food and beverages according to Olegio’s service standards.

\* Upsell menu items, desserts, beverages, and specialty products whenever appropriate.

\* Set up tables before service and clear, clean, and reset tables after guests leave.

\* Maintain cleanliness of the dining area, service stations, and restaurant equipment.

\* Coordinate effectively with the kitchen and bar to ensure smooth and timely service.

\* Process guest bills and payments accurately following company procedures.

\* Follow all food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and health regulations.

\* Maintain proper grooming, hygiene, and uniform standards at all times.

\* Assist with opening and closing duties, including polishing cutlery, folding napkins, stocking service stations, and preparing the restaurant for service.

\* Report guest feedback, complaints, maintenance issues, or operational concerns to the Restaurant Captain or Manager immediately.

\* Support team members and perform any additional duties assigned by management.

Qualifications

\* Higher Secondary School (12th Pass) or equivalent.

\* Previous experience in a restaurant, café, hotel, or fine dining establishment is preferred.

\* Freshers with a positive attitude and willingness to learn may also apply.

\* Basic English communication skills are required; knowledge of Hindi or Malayalam is an advantage.

Required Skills

\* Excellent customer service and hospitality skills.

\* Good communication and interpersonal skills.

\* Positive attitude with a pleasant personality.

\* Ability to work under pressure in a fast\-paced environment.

\* Team player with a willingness to learn.

\* Basic knowledge of food and beverage service.

\* Familiarity with POS systems is an added advantage.

Working Conditions

\* Rotational shifts, including weekends and public holidays.

\* Standing and walking for extended periods.

\* Ability to carry trays, plates, and service equipment safely.

Performance Standards

\* Deliver exceptional guest service that exceeds customer expectations.

\* Maintain Olegio’s standards of cleanliness, professionalism, and hospitality.

\* Ensure prompt, courteous, and efficient service at all times.

\* Comply with all company policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), food safety regulations, and workplace safety guidelines.

\* Contribute positively to teamwork and help create an outstanding dining experience for every guest.

Olegio Gastronomy Pvt. Ltd. is committed to delivering authentic European hospitality through exceptional food, outstanding service, and memorable guest experiences. title: Manager, OTCR, Risk Reporting
description:
Requisition Number: 63156
Job Location: Chennai, IND
Global Grade: Band 7
Work Type: Office Working
Employment Type: Permanent
Posting Start Date: 25/09/2026
Posting End Date: 10/10/2026
:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Operational, Technology and Cyber Risk (OTCR) organisation is instrumental in protecting and ensuring the resilience of Standard Chartered Bank’s operations, data, and IT systems by managing operational, technology and cyber risk across the enterprise. As a critical function reporting into the Group Chief Risk Officer (CRO), the Group OTCR team serves as the second line of defense for assuring that controls are implemented effectively, in accordance with the OTCR Framework, and for instilling a risk culture within the Bank.


The Assistant Manager, OTCR Reporting is a permanent role that requires knowledge and experience in data management and governance, development and delivery of internal risk reporting, a deep understanding of the Group’s operational risk events’ standards and a holistic understanding to regulatory expectations on operational loss reporting and data analytics. This role reports directly to the Senior Manager, OTCR Data Governance, Reporting \& Analytics.


The purpose of this role is to implement a robust data governance around internal risk reporting framework, identify and enable utilization of accurate and timely risk data, and deliver business efficiencies through automation and process optimization.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Internal Risk Reporting:**

• Responsibility for production of OTCR Risk Information Reports for regions, countries, businesses and functions within the Bank.
  

• Identify and respond to MI and reporting requirements to support the internal reporting requirements and committee paper preparations. Addressing the senior management requests for management information and reporting packs and updates.
  

• Lead multi\-business/function forums and working groups to solution for risk reporting issues, identify actions and drive remediation to completion.
  

• Lead engagement with key stakeholders to ensure that key risk drivers and business rationales are reflected in the commentary of risk reporting and that adequate attention is drawn on key insights from risk analysis.
  

• Determine new risk reporting requirements of the bank, continually enhance existing risk information reports and conceptualise development of risk information reports at appropriate levels of granularity.
  

• Implement automated solutions to monitor data quality and issue resolution
  

• Set up processes with embedded best in class data management practices  

  



**To deliver this the role holder must have:**

• Ability to identify and analyze risk data and communicate data\-driven insights to wider audience with diverse background
  

• A collaborative approach to ensure that the needs of stakeholders can be met, in order to support effective risk identification, prioritization and remediation
  

• An ability to drive innovation and change so as to enhance processes and achieve efficiencies and investment in people to ensure that staff are fully supported to be here for good.


**Governance**  

**The role holder is responsible for the following:**  

• Building a strong risk culture and good conduct in the OTCR organization
  

• Ensure compliance with Group Data Conduct Policy and its standards, Group Data Management Policy and its standards, Risk Reporting and Risk Data Aggregation Standards, and all other standards related to management and utilization of risk data, and risk reporting


**Strategy**  

• Prepare reports, packs and MI for senior committees and forums.
  

• Resolve audit findings; open/close related operational risk issues.
  

• Maintain a mature OTCR risk reporting process, including effective change management.
  

• Support OTCR risk type by monitoring OTCR compliance, informing about risk metrics and quarterly risk assessments, and improving control efficiency.
  

• Develop and support the strategic planning process (incl. prioritisation of strategic initiatives)
  

• Support the establishment of good culture and corporate identity by developing mission / value statements
  

• Align processes, resources\-planning and objectives with the strategy
  

• Provide support and insight into significant organizational changes (e.g., shift in strategic focus)
  

• Support business/ strategic planning activities by providing financial budgets and forecasts
  

• Address audit issues as they arise, incl. creation and closure of operational risk issues related to specific audit findings
  

• Support in the preparation of reports, packs and MI to senior executives including to the Board as required and Regulators
  

• Drive the strategic intent and agenda of the OTCR organisation through excellent reporting, data and MI, processes, and creating visibility of top risks across the Management Team


• Management of headcount, workforce governance, vacancies, and succession planning
  

• Communicate risk intelligence to stakeholders for principle and sub\-risk types of OTCR
  

• Prepare and present communications and MI to senior management
  

• Contribute to the development of performance management processes, to encourage the development of an appropriate risk culture and discipline.
  

• Establish and maintain a mature Risk Reporting Process for OTCR, including effective and efficient change management
  

• Support the Executive Director, OTCR Data Governance, Reporting and Analytics to build data analytics capabilities in the team with the aim to monitor compliance with OTCR requirements and provide insights for the risk metrics.
  

**Business**  

* Develop and maintain OTCR risk reporting capabilities, tools and processes to meet business needs.
* Deliver timely and accurate OTCR risk reports.
* Improve data management, governance and reporting through appropriate tools, automation and best practices.
* Strengthen data quality controls, escalate issues and support effective continuous monitoring.
* Partner with OTCR data owners to leverage data for risk reporting and insights.
* Maintain clear documentation and control requirements for the risk reporting process
**Processes**  

• Support the build of a mature and sustainable process to deliver timely and accurate OTCR Risk Metrics (data about for example Risk Events, Elevated Residual Risks, ICS Culture Quotient)
  

• Provide commentary \& insights to OTCR Risk Metrics
  

• Regularly review the monthly and quarterly performance of risk metrics, identifying any patterns, deteriorating trends, or emerging risks for escalation to the RFO or designated delegate.
  

• Monitor and manage the quality of data used in the OTCR Risk Reporting process (identify and assess issues, monitor closure and mitigation of those issues)
  

• Collaborate with OTCR Data Providers for timely and accurate metric results as well as metric reading
  

• Handle Manual Adjustments related to OTCR Risk Metrics (identification, impact assessment, documentation in central repository)
  

• Establish and maintain OTCR Risk Metrics documentation (including Report Specification, Metric Calculation Logic, List of Critical Risk Measures, List of Critical Data Elements)
  

• Engage in change risk and impact assessment for reporting changes triggered by Policy, System, Regulatory Changes
  

• Contribute to the design and implementation of effective continuous monitoring for Data Quality
  

• Support RCSA for the OTCR Risk Reporting process by providing challenges during KCI design and automations as well as evidencing for existing KCI attestation.
  

• Continuously look for areas to improve the operational efficiency and effectiveness of the OTCR risk management processes through optimization and automation


**Risk Management**  

• Define and design appropriate MI and communicate via reporting to relevant committees.
  

• Embed appropriate data quality controls and provide analysis to support effective Risk Management
  

• Ensure that all activities are in line with and support of the OTCR principal risk type under the Bank’s ERMF
  

• Ensure all activities are in line with and support the relevant data management and risk reporting internal polices and standards and external regulatory requirements and obligations
  

• Identify and assess the impact of data quality issues, analyse the root cause and escalate when necessary
  

• Provide commentary \& insights to critical and context OTCR risk metrics
  

• Ensure early identification and escalation of risks, issues, trends and developments to OTCR and relevant stakeholders.
  

• Provide insight and guidance on the interpretation of reported exceptions/analytics outputs so that appropriate actions can be taken by the Group OTCR function


**Governance**  

**The role holder is responsible for the following:**  

• Building a strong risk culture and good conduct in the OTCR organization
  

• Ensure compliance with Group Data Conduct Policy and its standards, Group Data Management Policy and its standards, Risk Reporting and Risk Data Aggregation Standards, and all other standards related to management and utilization of risk data, and risk reporting


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**

• Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  

• Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  

• Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  

• Demonstrating leadership ability to ensure that the team achieves the outcomes set out in the Bank's Conduct Risk framework.


**Key stakeholders**

• OTCR LT
  

• OTCR SPOC
  

• Risk \& CFCC COO
  

• Regional CRO
  

• Country OTCR Teams
  

• Global Head Reporting, Risk \& CFCC
  

• Group CISO Teams
  

• TTO Data Domain Owner
  

• Group CDO Teams
  

• HR Learning Capability
  

• Risk BPM Team
  

• Head Audit


**Other Responsibilities**  

• Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in the team; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats);


**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must\-have Skills**  

• Risk and Compliance
  

• Risk Reporting and Data Governance
  

• Analytical Thinking


**Other Skills**  

• Microsoft Excel and Data Analysis
  

• Effective Communication
  

• Business Partnering
  

• Business Process Improvement and Change Management


**Motivations**
---------------

• Solving complex risk\-data and reporting problems with disciplined analysis and sound judgement.
  

• Turning data into clear insights that strengthen senior\-management and committee decision\-making.
  

• Improving controls, data quality and reporting processes through collaboration, innovation and sustainable automation.


**Qualifications**
------------------

**Key Experiences**  

• Experience in OTCR or operational risk reporting, risk metrics, data governance and management information.
  

• Experience producing senior committee packs and communicating data\-driven insights to diverse stakeholders.
  

• Experience with data\-quality controls, RCSA/KCI processes, audit or issue remediation, change delivery and process automation.
  

• Advanced Microsoft Excel capability; knowledge of SQL and data visualisation tools is advantageous.
  

**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory):**  

• Industry related qualification in Operational Risk Management or Information \& Cyber Security, such as CISSP, CISM(P), and/or CRISC or equivalent experience
  

• Degree level education or equivalent
  

**Languages:** English


**About Standard Chartered**

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

**What we offer**

* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance,** with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* **Time\-off** including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

* **A continuous learning culture** to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------


As a Senior Workplace Coordinator, you will play a key role in ensuring our office operates smoothly, efficiently, and safely while fostering a welcoming and engaging workplace experience. This is a hands\-on, service\-oriented role which will involve working in **rotational shifts in our Bangalore office** and requires adaptability, problem\-solving, and strong communication skills. You will serve as a primary point of contact for employees, vendors, and building management, addressing day\-to\-day office needs, supporting events, and maintaining a high standard of operational excellence.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Conduct a daily walkthrough to ensure office spaces are clean, functional, and free of hazards.
* Manage **employee transport and cab operations** to support seamless daily commuting.
* Coordinate with transport vendors to ensure high service quality, route optimization, and timely schedules.
* Oversee compliance and safety protocols for all commute solutions and transport partners.
* Manage and respond to employee requests and grievances submitted through Jira, Slack, email, or other channels.
* Oversee day\-to\-day office operations, including F\&B and transport/commute programs, shipping and receiving (employee and business mail), office supply management, security, M\&E, and janitorial.
* Act as a liaison with building management to coordinate vendor access, maintenance requests, and other facility needs, ensuring safety, compliance, and engaging employee experience
* Support event planning and execution in collaboration with Workplace Managers, Event Coordinators, and Marketing. Plan, source, and execute events like month\-end happy hours and engagement pop\-ups.
* Assist in managing workplace projects, including office moves, adds, and changes, occupancy planning, design \& build turnkey projects, rennovation, ensuring seamless transitions for employees.
* Maintain emergency preparedness by holding an emergency warden role and being First Aid and CPR certified.
* Ensure vendors and service providers meet performance expectations, including day porters, janitorial teams, and F\&B vendors, via a centrally coordinated FM model.
* Independently execute employee engagement initiatives, such as themed happy hours or other workplace experience programs.
* Develop and document workplace procedures, operational guides, and training materials to enhance efficiency and self\-sufficiency.
* Cross\-train to provide coverage for the Workplace Manager, ensuring seamless operations when they are out of office.
* Build workplace reports with Data \& Analytics insight. Hands on expertise in Workplace Analytics \& PropTech Enablement and content creation to manage employee facing confluence/source pages.
* Maintains logs, trackers \& occurrences register. Funnels all information as per escalation matrix to vendor \& all internal stakeholders.
* Manage and coordinate vendor payments, ensuring timely processing of invoices and accurate record\-keeping.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Graduate with working knowledge of Electricals, Diesel Generators \& HVAC (Heating, Ventilation \& Air Conditioning), FAS (Fire Automation System), PAS (Public Address System) \& ACS (Access Control Systems).
* 5\+ years of experience in Transport operations, Workplace Operations, Facilities, Real Estate, or a fast\-paced service industry such as retail, hospitality, or restaurants.
* Proven track record in **transport management, vendor coordination, and commute operations**.
* Ability to handle a high volume of requests while maintaining a calm, professional, and solution\-oriented approach.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, demonstrating initiative in identifying and implementing workplace improvements.
* Highly organized with grit, tenacity, and resilience, understanding that workplace operations may require non\-traditional hours.
* Experience working in Jira, Slack, or similar ticketing/communication platforms is a plus.
* Comfortable managing multiple vendors, coordinating maintenance requests, and working closely with building management.
* Passion for creating a positive and engaging office environment that enhances employee productivity and connection.
* Willing to work in the office Monday–Friday, on rotational shifts involving nights and occasionally during weekends for events or critical vendor work.
* Understanding of global real estate operations and cross\-cultural collaboration.
* Additional language skills relevant to region/area (if preferable)

 **Note**:

* This is a full\-time, in\-office role (Monday to Friday)
* This role requires you to work in rotational shifts.

title: General Manager
description:
**Job Title:** General Manager / Executive Manager – Strategy \& Operations

**Department:** Executive Management / Operations

**Industry:** Healthcare / Retail Pharmacy

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly driven, execution\-oriented General Manager / Executive Manager to serve as the primary integration and operational support for the Managing Director. This role is central to driving operational discipline, accountability, and execution speed across a multi\-branch pharmacy network. The successful candidate will bridge the gap between strategic planning and daily operations, ensuring that management priorities are instantly converted into clear action points and rigorously tracked to closure without requiring continuous MD intervention.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Execution \& Tracking**

* Convert MD decisions, strategies, and priorities into structured, step\-by\-step action plans with clear owners and deadlines.
* Track critical tasks, departmental deadlines, and project closures systematically.
* Maintain a clear, continuously updated priority and action tracker for executive review.
* Operate with a solution\-oriented mindset, proactively presenting viable solutions alongside any escalated problems.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Coordination**

* Drive execution across multiple branches and core functional departments, including Operations, HR, Finance, Purchase, IT, and Distribution.
* Confidently follow up with senior department heads and branch managers to ensure strict accountability and timely delivery on commitments.
* Identify operational gaps, bottlenecks, and project delays early, resolving them before they escalate into major issues.
* Separate routine operational matters from critical issues, ensuring daily follow\-ups are closed at the appropriate management tier.
* Champion the continuous improvement of operational systems, reporting standards, and branch coordination across the entire pharmacy chain.

**Executive Support \& Management Reporting**

* Manage high\-level management meetings by preparing agendas, capturing precise Minutes of Meeting (MOM), and driving all post\-meeting action items.
* Synthesize raw operational data into concise management updates, leveraging Excel, Google Sheets, and business dashboards.
* Act as an effective filter for the MD, escalating only major risks, severe delays, or critical exceptions requiring executive approval.
* Handle highly sensitive business, financial, and personnel information with absolute confidentiality and professionalism.

**Qualifications \& Ideal Profile**

**Experience \& Domain Expertise**

* **Tenure:** **4\* to** 8 \*years of relevant strategic or operational leadership experience.
* **Industry Requirement:** Mandatory background in the Healthcare or Pharmacy industry.
* **Preferred Sectors:** Exceptional preference given to candidates with direct experience in Chain Retail Pharmacy, Multi\-branch Pharmacy Operations, Pharmacy Distribution linked with Retail, or Healthcare Retail.
* *(Note: Experience solely in unrelated industries will not be considered).*

**Core Competencies**

* Deep practical understanding of pharmacy store operations, including purchasing, inventory management, stock movement, customer service, and regulatory compliance.
* Highly organized, disciplined, and relentless in follow\-up.
* Strong bias for execution—capable of moving swiftly from planning and discussion to on\-the\-ground implementation.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to learn quickly and adapt to fast\-changing business needs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills tailored for executive\-level interaction.

**Core Success Measure**

The ultimate success in this role is defined by a tangible reduction in routine MD involvement, paired with a noticeable improvement in execution speed, branch coordination, organizational accountability, and operational discipline across the entire retail pharmacy chain.

title: Store Manager
description:
About Knya Knya is a funded, fast\-growing D2C brand redefining healthcare apparel for modern professionals, backed by DSG Consumer Partners. We combine functionality, comfort, and aesthetics to serve a community that deserves more from their workwear. Our culture values ownership, experimentation, speed, and customer obsession.

What Are You Entering Into Knya is one of India's fastest\-growing healthcare apparel brands and we're just getting started. When you join us, you're not filling a seat. You're stepping into a company that is actively being built, where the work you do today shapes what Knya looks like tomorrow. We're a team of driven people who care deeply about what we're building, move with purpose, and back each other to grow. If you're looking for a place where your contribution is visible, your growth is real, and your work actually matters to the people who wear what we make, this is it.

Role Overview You will run a Knya store like it's your own. Our customers are doctors, nurses and healthcare students who come in between shifts, and they deserve a store that respects their time and their profession. You own the numbers, the team, the stock and the standards, and you make sure every customer walks out with the right fit and a reason to come back.

You report to the Area Manager and work closely with the Retail, HR and Finance teams. Key Responsibilities

Sales \& Store Performance **Own the monthly sales target for your store and plan daily and weekly how the team gets there.** 

Track sales, bill value and conversion every day, and act early when the numbers slip. **Build local demand by reaching out to nearby hospitals, medical colleges and clinics for walk\-ins and bulk orders.** 

Drive high\-value bills through strong product knowledge, fit guidance and genuine recommendations. Customer Experience **Serve every customer like a caregiver. Anticipate what they need, remove friction and make their day easier.** 

Know the product at expert level: fabric, fit, care and durability, and make sure your team does too.

**Understand our customers' world, from hospital dress codes to shift timings, and use it to guide them better.**  Handle exchanges, complaints and escalations calmly and resolve them on the spot wherever possible

Team Leadership **Lead, coach and motivate your store team. Set clear daily goals and give honest, regular feedback.** 

Plan rosters and weekly offs so the store is always well staffed at peak hours.

**Make sure attendance, leaves and punches are recorded correctly in Keka every day.**  Onboard new joiners into the Knya way of working and help identify and grow future store leaders.

**Set the tone on grooming, conduct and professionalism. Your team will follow what you do.** 

**Operations, Stock \& Compliance**  Own inventory accuracy. Run regular stock counts, flag variances and keep shrinkage close to zero.

**Manage cash handling and deposit store cash on time, with daily reconciliation against sales.**  Keep billing clean and accurate, with every sale punched correctly at the time of sale.

**Ensure CCTV, POS and store systems are working at all times and report issues the same day.**  Maintain visual merchandising, folds, sizing displays and store upkeep to Knya standards, every single day.

**Follow company SOPs and policies, and share accurate daily and monthly reports with your Area Manager. Ownership \& Community**  Treat the store as a professional gathering point for the healthcare community in your city.

**Bring ideas on what is working locally, what customers are asking for and what we should try next.** 

**ust Haves**  3 to 6 years of retail experience, with at least 1 to 2 years managing a store or leading a floor team. **Proven track record of hitting sales targets.**  Hands\-on experience with inventory management, stock audits, cash handling and POS billing.

**Comfortable with numbers and basic reporting in Excel or Google Sheets.**  Strong communication in English and the local language.

**Willingness to work on weekends, public holidays and in retail shift timings.**  High integrity. You will be trusted with cash, stock and people.

Good to Have **Experience in apparel, fashion, lifestyle or premium retail brands.**  Exposure to healthcare, medical or uniform retail, or an understanding of how hospitals and medical colleges work.

**Experience driving B2B or bulk orders from local institutions.** 

Familiarity with HRMS tools like Keka for attendance and rosters.

**Experience opening or setting up a new store.**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* what is your current salary?
* what's your expected salary?
* what's your notice period?

Work Location: In person

title: Sr. Executive HR - Payroll
description:
Monthly Payroll Processing

* Process monthly payroll for employees across multiple branches and locations.
* Collect, verify, consolidate, and validate monthly salary inputs.
* Ensure accurate processing of **basic salary, HRA, allowances, incentives, deductions, LOP, arrears, revisions, and recoveries**.
* Verify new joiners, transfers, promotions, increments, and employee exits before payroll processing.
* Ensure payroll is processed within the defined monthly payroll calendar.

2\. Attendance \& Leave Management

* Collect and verify **biometric attendance** data from branches.
* Monitor attendance, late coming, absenteeism, LOP, leave, weekly offs, and holidays.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers and HR teams for attendance corrections and approvals.
* Ensure attendance data is properly reconciled before salary processing.
* Monitor leave balances and ensure approved leave is correctly reflected in payroll.

3\. Employee Master Data

* Maintain accurate employee master data relating to:
* Employee ID
* DOJ/DOL
* Designation
* Department
* Branch/Location
* Salary structure
* Bank details
* PAN/Aadhaar and other statutory details
* EPF/UAN
* ESIC/IP number
* Professional Tax details
* Update employee master data for transfers, promotions, increments, salary revisions, and other changes.

4\. Incentive \& Variable Pay

* Collect and verify monthly incentive statements from respective departments.
* Coordinate with Sales, Service, Parts, and other functional teams for incentive inputs.
* Validate incentive calculations against approved incentive structures.
* Ensure approved incentives are correctly included in payroll.

5\. Statutory Compliance

Coordinate with the HR/Finance team for payroll\-related statutory compliance, including:

* **EPF / PF**
* **ESIC**
* **Professional Tax**
* **TDS**
* **Labour Welfare Fund**
* Other applicable statutory deductions and contributions.

Ensure payroll data reconciles with statutory returns and challans.

6\. Full \& Final Settlement

* Process Full \& Final settlements for resigned, retired, terminated, and separated employees.
* Calculate:
* Salary payable
* LOP
* Leave encashment
* Incentives
* Gratuity, wherever applicable
* Notice\-period recovery/pay
* Loans/advances
* Other recoveries
* Coordinate with HR, Finance, and concerned departments for clearance and settlement.

7\. Payroll Reconciliation

* Reconcile payroll with attendance and employee master data.
* Verify total **headcount and monthly salary payout** branch\-wise.
* Identify discrepancies in salary, employee count, deductions, incentives, and arrears.
* Prepare reconciliation between payroll register, bank payment file, and accounting records.
* Ensure the final payroll total matches the approved monthly payout.

8\. Payroll MIS \& Reporting

Prepare regular payroll\-related MIS reports such as:

* Branch\-wise headcount
* Branch\-wise salary cost
* Department\-wise salary cost
* New joiners
* Separations
* Transfers
* Promotions
* Increment statements
* LOP report
* Incentive report
* Overtime, where applicable
* Attendance summary
* Payroll variance report
* Statutory deduction summary
* Monthly salary payout statement

9\. Coordination with Branches

* Coordinate with Branch Managers, HR representatives, and functional heads for timely submission of payroll inputs.
* Follow up on pending attendance corrections, leave approvals, incentives, and other salary inputs.
* Ensure all branches comply with the monthly payroll cut\-off dates.

10\. Payroll System / HRMS

* Maintain payroll and employee records in the Company's **HRMS/Payroll system**.
* Ensure proper integration/reconciliation between biometric attendance, HRMS, and payroll.
* Troubleshoot payroll\-related system issues and coordinate with IT/software vendors where required.

**The AVP – Employee Relations and Compliance** is responsible for developing, governing, and executing the employee relations and HR regulatory compliance framework for the India GCC. This role ensures adherence to applicable labour and employment laws, statutory obligations, employee relations processes, workplace investigations, and compliance governance requirements.


The incumbent will serve as the compliance subject matter expert and governance lead, partnering closely with Legal, Payroll, HR Operations, Facilities, Procurement, external labour compliance vendors, and business leaders to mitigate risk, maintain audit readiness, and ensure an equitable, compliant, and positive employee experience.


The role will be accountable for labour compliance oversight, regulatory monitoring, statutory inspections, compliance audits, policy governance, employee grievance management, disciplinary processes, and employee relations strategy across the India organization.

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. Regulatory Compliance Governance**


–Own and lead the end\-to\-end employment and labour compliance framework for the India GCC.


–Ensure compliance with applicable Central and State employment laws, labour regulations, and statutory obligations.


–Establish governance mechanisms for monitoring compliance obligations, statutory filings, registrations, renewals, notices, record maintenance, and payments.


–Build and maintain a compliance calendar and compliance dashboard covering all employment\-related statutory requirements.


–Monitor regulatory changes and assess business impact, ensuring timely implementation of new compliance requirements.


–Drive compliance awareness and training programs for People leaders and employees.


–Act as the primary compliance escalation point for labour law matters.

**2\. Labour Law \& Statutory Compliance Management**


–Oversee compliance with employment related legislation


–Ensure statutory filings, registrations, renewals, inspections, notices, and returns are completed accurately and within timelines.


–Partner with Payroll and HR Operations to ensure all payroll\-linked statutory requirements are met.

**3\. Employee Relations \& Workplace Governance**


–Develop and execute the Employee Relations strategy for the GCC.


–Lead employee grievance resolution, disciplinary actions, misconduct investigations, workplace complaints, and conflict management.


–Drive fair, consistent, and legally compliant employee relations processes.


–Support leaders with performance\-related employee matters, conduct concerns, workplace disputes, and behavioral issues.


–Ensure compliance with internal policies, code of conduct requirements, and ethical standards.


–Partner with Legal where required on complex employee matters and litigation risks.


–Lead workplace investigations and ensure appropriate documentation, governance, and closure.

**4\. Compliance Vendor \& Regulatory Relationship Management**


–Manage relationships with external labour compliance vendors and legal advisors.


–Oversee labour law registrations, statutory record maintenance, compliance audits, regulatory filings, and labour inspection support through vendors.


–Coordinate responses to government authorities, inspectors, labour departments, and other regulators.


–Monitor vendor performance through SLAs, audit outcomes, compliance metrics, and governance reviews.


–Serve as the internal liaison for all labour compliance related regulatory interactions.

**5\. Audit, Risk \& Controls**


–Lead labour compliance audits and compliance self\-assessments.


–Ensure organizational readiness for internal audits, regulatory inspections, external audits, and diligence exercises.


–Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies for emerging compliance risks.


–Develop controls to ensure sustainable compliance adherence.


–Drive corrective action tracking and closure of audit observations.


–Maintain evidence repositories and statutory documentation for audit purposes.

**6\. Policy Governance \& Employee Experience**


–Own policy governance for employment\-related policies and procedures.


–Review, update, and implement policies to align with legislative and organizational requirements.


–Ensure compliance requirements are embedded into employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, transfers, promotions, leave management, separations, contractor management, and workforce engagement.


–Partner with business and People leaders to maintain a positive employee experience while ensuring compliance and risk mitigation.

**7\. Reporting, Analytics \& Governance Forums**


–Develop compliance dashboards and executive reporting mechanisms.


–Provide regular updates to GCC Leadership and People Leadership teams on compliance status, risks, audits, investigations, and corrective actions.


–Use compliance and employee relations data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Master’s degree in law, Employment Law, Labour Relations, Human Resources, or related discipline.
* Strong understanding of Indian labour laws and employment compliance and regulatory frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of employee relations and workplace governance practices
* Experience managing employment compliance audits, investigations, and labour inspections.
* Certifications in Labour Laws, Compliance, Industrial Relations, or Compliance Management are preferred.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**


–15\+ years of experience in HR Compliance, Employee Relations, Labour Relations, HR Operations, or Industrial Relations.


–Experience in BFSI GCC, multinational corporations, or regulated environments is strongly preferred.


–Experience working with external compliance and payroll vendors.


–Demonstrated experience managing labour inspections, audits, regulatory inquiries, and investigations.


–Strong experience designing scalable compliance governance frameworks.

**CORE COMPETENCY \& BEHAVIOURAL DESCRIPTION**

* Regulatory Compliance Expertise: Deep understanding of labour laws, statutory requirements, regulatory frameworks, and compliance governance.
* Employee Relations: Strong capability in grievance management, investigations, disciplinary processes, and workplace conflict resolution.
* Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, mitigate, and monitor compliance and employee relations risks proactively.
* Audit \& Controls: Experience designing compliance controls and driving audit readiness.
* Stakeholder Management: Ability to partner effectively with business leaders, legal teams, payroll teams, regulators, and external vendors.
* Policy Governance: Strong capability in developing, reviewing, and implementing policies and compliance frameworks.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to use compliance data and people analytics to drive decisions and identify emerging risks.
* Communication \& Influence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence leaders at all levels.
* Investigation \& Judgment: Demonstrated capability to conduct impartial investigations and make sound risk\-based decisions.
